+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridFilter, DataGridProps, DataGridState } from './index';
+import { FILTER_DELAY } from './parts/FilterCell';
+
+// The filter row (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 F1 "Hàng lọc", §6.3 "Lọc"): its structure, the text, boolean and
+// lookup cells, the operator button and the one menu of the grid, and the keys that reach it. What needs a
+// layout engine or the top layer to be true (the sizes, the menu under its button, a sticky row, the
+// focus after a popup closes in each engine) is proven in the stories (`DataGridFiltering.stories.tsx`).
+
+// How many times a popover was shown, and which are showing: jsdom has no Popover API.
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  showing = new Set();
+  // jsdom has no layout, so every element would count as hidden to the code that looks for the
+  // controls of a cell.
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => {};
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  paid: boolean;
+  status: number;
+  qty: number;
+}
+
+const STATUS = {
+  items: [
+    { id: 1, name: 'New' },
+    { id: 2, name: 'Done' },
+    { id: 3, name: 'Cancelled' },
+  ],
+  valueField: 'id',
+  displayField: 'name',
+};
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1', customer: 'Công ty Minh Phát', paid: true, status: 1, qty: 3 },
+  { id: 'DH-2', customer: 'Nguyễn Minh Anh', paid: false, status: 2, qty: 12 },
+  { id: 'DH-3', customer: 'Lê Quang Huy', paid: true, status: 2, qty: 21 },
+  { id: 'DH-4', customer: 'Đường Sắt', paid: false, status: 3, qty: 4 },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 104, allowFiltering: false },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 200 },
+  { field: 'paid', caption: 'Paid', dataType: 'boolean', width: 90 },
+  { field: 'status', caption: 'Status', width: 120, lookup: STATUS },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 80 },
+];
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      filterRow
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+/** A grid whose parent holds the filter, as the parent of a controlled grid does. */
+function Held({
+  onChange,
+  start = {},
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & {
+  onChange?: (filter: DataGridFilter) => void;
+  start?: DataGridFilter;
+}) {
+  const [filter, setFilter] = useState(start);
+  return (
+    <>
+      <button type="button" onClick={() => setFilter({ columns: { customer: { value: 'huy' } } })}>
+        set outside
+      </button>
+      <Orders
+        filter={filter}
+        onFilterChange={(next) => {
+          onChange?.(next);
+          setFilter(next);
+        }}
+        {...props}
+      />
+    </>
+  );
+}
+
+const grid = () => screen.getByRole('grid') as HTMLTableElement;
+const headRows = () => Array.from(grid().tHead!.rows);
+const filterRow = () => headRows()[1]!;
+// The cells of the filter row, the filler column's not counted.
+const filterCells = () =>
+  Array.from(filterRow().cells).filter((cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'));
+const filterCell = (index: number) => filterCells()[index]!;
+const CUSTOMER = 1;
+const PAID = 2;
+const STATUS_AT = 3;
+const QTY = 4;
+const title = (caption: string) =>
+  Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('thead > tr:first-child > th')).find((th) =>
+    th.textContent?.startsWith(caption),
+  )!;
+const input = () => screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Filter Customer' }) as HTMLInputElement;
+const operatorButton = (name = 'Operator: Contains') =>
+  screen.getByRole('button', { name }) as HTMLButtonElement;
+const menu = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-operator-menu');
+const radios = () =>
+  Array.from(menu()?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitemradio"]') ?? []);
+const radio = (name: string) => radios().find((item) => item.textContent === name)!;
+const bodyRows = () => Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('tbody > tr'));
+const customers = () => bodyRows().map((row) => row.children[1]!.textContent);
+const stops = () => Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[tabindex="0"]'));
+const focusOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.focus());
+/** A key pressed on `element`; true when it was cancelled. */
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, key: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, { key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...init });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+const type = (text: string) => fireEvent.change(input(), { target: { value: text } });
+const advance = (ms: number) => act(() => void vi.advanceTimersByTime(ms));
+/** The listbox option of a Select in a cell (the native `<select>` has one of the same name). */
+const option = (cell: HTMLElement, name: string) =>
+  within(cell)
+    .getAllByRole('option', { name, hidden: true })
+    .find((candidate) => candidate.id !== '')!;
+/** A press and a click on a button, as a mouse makes them. */
+function click(button: HTMLElement) {
+  fireEvent.pointerDown(button, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1 });
+  fireEvent.mouseDown(button);
+  fireEvent.pointerUp(button, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 0 });
+  fireEvent.click(button, { detail: 1 });
+}
+const lastFilter = (spy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>) => spy.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0];
+

+    }

+
+  it('has a cell for each shown column in the order of the columns, and follows a hidden one', () => {

+    expect(

+    rerender(

+        columnLayout={{

+        }}

+    expect(filterCells()).toHaveLength(4);

+
+  it('carries the alignment and the pin of its column, as its title does', () => {

+
+  it('has a service cell with no content for the column of boxes, and the filler column its own cell', () => {
+    render(<Orders selectionMode="multiple" />);
+    const service = filterCells()[0]!;
+    expect(service).toHaveAttribute('data-service');

+/**
+ * How long a story waits for the filter row to apply what it was given: the 400 ms of its delay, then the

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  firstRowIndex,
+  headRowAt,
+  headRowCount,
+  isFilterPlace,
+  isTitlePlace,
+  listIndexOf,
+  titleRow,
+} from './grid-dom';
+
+// The rows of the heading and where the keyboard counts them from (spec phase 6 §3.6): the places of the
+// heading count up from the body, so -1 is the last heading row, which is the filter row when there is one.
+
+function tableOf(headRows: number, withIndex: boolean) {
+  const table = document.createElement('table');
+  const head = table.createTHead();
+  for (let index = 0; index < headRows; index++) head.insertRow();
+  const body = table.createTBody();
+  const row = body.insertRow();
+  if (withIndex) row.setAttribute('aria-rowindex', String(firstRowIndex(headRows) + 4));
+  return { table, row };
+}
+
+describe('the heading rows', () => {
+  it('are one, or two with a filter row', () => {
+    expect(headRowCount(false)).toBe(1);
+    expect(headRowCount(true)).toBe(2);
+  });
+
+  it('are counted before the rows of data in aria-rowindex', () => {
+    expect(firstRowIndex(1)).toBe(2);
+    expect(firstRowIndex(2)).toBe(3);
+  });
+
+  it('tell the titles from the filter row by the place and the number of heading rows', () => {
+    // One heading row: -1 is the titles and there is no filter row.
+    expect(isTitlePlace(-1, 1)).toBe(true);
+    expect(isFilterPlace(-1, 1)).toBe(false);
+    // Two: -2 is the titles, -1 the filter row.
+    expect(isTitlePlace(-2, 2)).toBe(true);
+    expect(isTitlePlace(-1, 2)).toBe(false);
+    expect(isFilterPlace(-1, 2)).toBe(true);
+    expect(isFilterPlace(-2, 2)).toBe(false);
+    // A row of the body is neither.
+    expect(isTitlePlace(0, 1)).toBe(false);
+    expect(isFilterPlace(0, 2)).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('give the row at a place of the heading, and the titles are always the first', () => {
+    const one = tableOf(1, false).table;
+    expect(headRowAt(one, -1)).toBe(one.tHead!.rows[0]);
+    expect(titleRow(one)).toBe(one.tHead!.rows[0]);
+    const two = tableOf(2, false).table;
+    expect(headRowAt(two, -2)).toBe(two.tHead!.rows[0]);
+    expect(headRowAt(two, -1)).toBe(two.tHead!.rows[1]);
+    expect(titleRow(two)).toBe(two.tHead!.rows[0]);
+    expect(headRowAt(one, -2)).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(titleRow(null)).toBeNull();
+    expect(titleRow(document.createElement('table'))).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('are read from the table by the place a row says it has in the list', () => {
+    expect(listIndexOf(tableOf(1, true).row, 0)).toBe(4);
+    expect(listIndexOf(tableOf(2, true).row, 0)).toBe(4);
+    // A row that says nothing is where it is drawn.
+    expect(listIndexOf(tableOf(2, false).row, 7)).toBe(7);
+  });
+});

 **Mô hình focus** (mẫu data grid của APG):
 
 - **Một điểm Tab.** Đúng một phần tử trong bảng có `tabindex="0"`: ô đang hoạt động (hay hàng nhóm đang hoạt động, hay control duy nhất của ô, bên dưới); mọi ô khác và mọi control trong ô `tabindex="-1"`. Thanh công cụ, thanh lưu, thanh bộ lọc và thanh phân trang là các điểm Tab riêng trước và sau bảng. Khung cuộn mang `tabindex="-1"` cố định (không bao giờ đổi, không có `role`): Firefox đưa một phần tử cuộn được vào thứ tự Tab nếu nó không có `tabindex`, kể cả khi trong nó đã có ô là điểm Tab; `-1` giữ khung ngoài thứ tự Tab mà vẫn không bị gỡ khi đang giữ focus (phát hiện khi lập Plan B). Control trong ô tuỳ biến (`cell`) được grid đặt `tabindex="-1"` sau mỗi lần commit, nhớ giá trị cũ của từng cái và trả đúng giá trị đó khi grid biến mất; nút sắp xếp ở tiêu đề cũng vậy (phát hiện khi lập Plan B). Control mà ô tự thêm khi render riêng (không có commit nào của grid: link đến sau một lần tải, `Suspense` xong) cũng được đặt `-1`, qua một `MutationObserver` (`childList`, `subtree`) trên `<tbody>`, chỉ có khi grid có cột `cell` và gỡ khi không còn; observer đó cũng nghe `attributes` (`attributeFilter`: `disabled`, `tabindex`, `href`, `contenteditable`, `hidden`, `inert`), nên control mà ô làm thành điểm Tab bằng một thuộc tính (nút ô tự bật sau một lần tải, link có `href`, `tabindex` roving mà ô tự chuyển) cũng được đặt `-1`; observer chỉ xem các ô của bảng mà bản ghi nằm trong và các dòng được thêm vào (cửa sổ dời, dòng đến), không đi lại cả `<tbody>` (vòng sửa thứ hai); bản ghi của chính các lần ghi của grid được lấy đi bằng `takeRecords()` ngay sau khi ghi (lần ghi là đồng bộ, nên không lấy mất gì khác), nên observer không đọc chúng và không chạy lại; một `tabindex` ô ghi sau grid là của ô: giá trị từ 0 trở lên được lấy lại cùng giá trị mới để trả, giá trị âm ở nguyên và không được trả khi grid biến mất (phát hiện khi review PR #42); control nằm trong popup của ô (`[popover]`, `dialog`) giữ nguyên `tabindex` của nó, vì popup là chỗ riêng như với phím và lần nhấn; cả hai qua một hook `use-release-controls.ts` mà nút ở tiêu đề của C và trình sửa của F dùng lại (phát hiện khi review cuối Plan B).
+- **Hàng lọc là một hàng của grid** (phát hiện khi lập Plan D): ô của nó là ô lưới (`td.flg-table-cell.flg-data-grid-filter-cell`, `tabindex` 0/-1, `data-align` và thuộc tính ghim của cột, key React là id cột; cột ô chọn có ô dịch vụ `data-service` không nội dung, cột không lọc (`allowFiltering` tắt) có ô trống, chỗ của cột đệm như ở hàng tiêu đề). Chỗ của bàn phím đếm các hàng tiêu đề từ thân bảng lên: -1 là hàng tiêu đề cuối (hàng lọc nếu có, không thì hàng tiêu đề), -2 là hàng tiêu đề khi có hàng lọc (`isTitlePlace`, `isFilterPlace` của `grid-dom.ts`; mọi chỗ trước đây hỏi "đang ở tiêu đề" bằng `row < 0` nay hỏi hai hàm này, và `titleRow(table)` là `<tr>` tiêu đề trong DOM, luôn là hàng đầu của `<thead>`). `ActiveCell.area` thêm `'filter'`: tắt `filterRow` khi chỗ đang ở hàng lọc thì chỗ là tiêu đề của cột đó (focus theo sang đó nếu đang trong grid), bật `filterRow` thì chỗ ở tiêu đề vẫn ở tiêu đề. `↑` từ dòng đầu lên hàng lọc rồi hàng tiêu đề, `↓` ngược lại; `Home`/`End` trong hàng; ô lọc giữ focus (không bao giờ control của nó: `Select` sẽ nhận `↓`); `Enter` và `F2` vào control giá trị (input hoặc trigger của Select, không phải nút toán tử), `Tab` đi vòng các control của ô, `Esc`/`F2` về ô; gõ một ký tự in được trên ô không làm gì (không có "gõ để lọc" ở Plan D); phím của cột (đổi cỡ, di chuyển, menu cột, `Enter` sắp xếp) chỉ ở hàng tiêu đề, còn `Space` trên ô lọc bị huỷ như trên tiêu đề. `aria-rowindex`: tiêu đề 1, hàng lọc 2, dòng đầu 3 (`firstRowIndex(headRows)`), `aria-rowcount` = số hàng tiêu đề + số dòng.
 - **Vị trí hoạt động** lưu bằng (khoá dòng hoặc khoá nhóm, id cột), không bằng chỉ số DOM, nên sắp xếp, lọc, cuộn ảo không làm mất chỗ. Lúc đầu: ô đầu của dòng thân đầu tiên (không có dòng: ô tiêu đề đầu). Dòng hoạt động biến mất (lọc, xoá) thì vị trí chuyển sang dòng cùng chỉ số (kẹp lại), và nếu focus đang ở trong grid thì focus theo sang đó ("trong grid" là trong DOM của bảng: sự kiện focus của một portal mà ô mở, như popover của thư viện ngoài, đi qua bảng trong cây React nhưng không tính, nên focus trong portal không bị kéo về ô hoạt động khi grid render lại; phát hiện khi review cuối Plan B). Vị trí cũng nhớ chỉ số dòng lần cuối thấy nó; dòng ở chỉ số đó còn mang khoá ấy thì chính nó là dòng hoạt động, không thì là dòng đầu tiên mang khoá, nên hai dòng cùng khoá (grid cảnh báo) không làm phím bị khoá ở dòng thứ hai (phát hiện khi review PR #42). Vị trí cũng nhớ chỉ số cột lần cuối thấy nó: cột hoạt động biến mất (ẩn, gỡ) thì vị trí chuyển sang cột đang ở chỉ số đó (kẹp lại), như với dòng, thay vì về cột đầu tiên; cột chỉ đổi chỗ thì vị trí đi theo id của nó (phát hiện khi lập Plan C). Grid trống do lọc (G1 "Trống") có nút "Clear filter" trong ô trải mọi cột: lúc đó ô trống là một ô của grid, là vị trí duy nhất của thân bảng, nút là "nhà" của nó (`data-home="control"`, như ô chọn là nhà của ô ở cột chọn dòng); không dòng nào thì vị trí lúc đầu là nút, ↓ từ hàng tiêu đề cuối tới nút (giữ cột đang đứng), ↑ về tiêu đề của cột đó, ←, →, Home, End, ↓ đứng yên, Enter và Space bấm nút, bấm vào ô là đặt vị trí ở đó; đúng một `tabindex="0"` trong bảng. Bấm nút thì bộ lọc xoá, các dòng trở lại và vị trí là ô đầu của dòng đầu, focus theo sang nếu đang ở nút (phát hiện khi lập Plan D). Grid trống không do lọc (`labels.noData`) không đổi: không nút, ô tiêu đề là vị trí.
 - **Ô chỉ có một control đơn giản** (ô chọn của cột chọn dòng, ô chọn tất cả ở tiêu đề, nút mở chi tiết, tay nắm kéo dòng): chính control đó là đích của focus (APG), Space/Enter tác động thẳng lên nó. Phát hiện khi lập Plan B: ô giữ `tabindex="-1"` còn control giữ `tabindex` 0/-1; grid cuộn **ô** vào tầm nhìn chứ không cuộn control (control 16px trong dòng 41px sẽ để dòng ở mép khung bị cắt); `Enter` bấm control (`click()`), còn `Space` do grid xử lý ở `keydown` (chọn / chọn khoảng, `preventDefault`) (huỷ `keydown` thì cả ba engine không bấm checkbox ở `keyup`; story `Selecting` chứng minh Space chọn đúng một lần); ô chọn ở tiêu đề giữ `Space` nguyên bản (nó là control riêng, không thuộc dòng nào). Khi ô chọn ở tiêu đề bị tắt (phạm vi rỗng) thì không focus được, nên chính ô tiêu đề là điểm Tab và đích của focus (phát hiện khi lập Plan B). Đích của ô hoạt động đổi trong lúc focus ở trong ô (ô chọn ở tiêu đề bật lên khi dòng đến lúc ô tiêu đề đang giữ focus, hay tắt đi khi dòng hết lúc chính nó giữ focus) thì sau lần commit đó focus sang đích mới (`preventScroll`), vì phím được đọc từ đích; cả ba engine giữ focus trên control vừa bị tắt ít nhất một khung hình rồi mới đưa nó về `<body>`, nên lần commit kịp chuyển nó (phát hiện khi review PR #42).
 - **Ô có nhiều control** (tiêu đề cột có nút sắp xếp, phễu, ⋮; cột thao tác; `cell` tuỳ biến có link hay nút; dòng chi tiết): focus nằm trên ô; `Enter` hoặc `F2` vào "chế độ widget": focus sang control đầu, `Tab`/`Shift+Tab` đi vòng trong các control của ô, `Esc` hoặc `F2` về ô. Bấm chuột vào một control trong ô đặt ô đó làm ô hoạt động. Tiêu đề cột: `Enter` là sắp xếp (bản quyết định), nên chỉ `F2` vào các nút của nó. Control có popup đang mở (`aria-expanded="true"`, như Select) giữ `Esc` cho nó: trình duyệt tự đóng popup bằng `Esc` mà không `preventDefault` phím, nên grid không thể biết qua `defaultPrevented`; `Esc` kế tiếp mới là của grid (phát hiện khi lập Plan B).
@@ -554,7 +555,7 @@ Trong mục này "kính" là lớp `flg-surface`; "focus chung" là `outline: 2p
 
 #### DataGrid: lọc (F1)
 
-- **Hàng lọc** (`.flg-data-grid-filter-row`, hàng thứ hai của `<thead>`): ô padding `6px 5px`, ô đầu padding trái 8px, ô cuối padding phải 8px, căn giữa dọc; nền như ô tiêu đề.
+- **Hàng lọc** (`.flg-data-grid-filter-row`, hàng thứ hai của `<thead>`): ô padding `6px 5px`, ô đầu padding trái 8px, ô cuối padding phải 8px, căn giữa dọc; nền như ô tiêu đề. Phát hiện khi lập Plan D: ô mang `flg-table-cell` (nền đặc của header dính, đường kẻ dưới và ghim là của Table), ô cuối là ô thật cuối (`:nth-last-child(1 of .flg-data-grid-filter-cell)`, cột đệm không tính); chữ trong ô thừa hưởng độ đậm `semibold` của ô tiêu đề đúng như mockup, còn `text-transform` và `letter-spacing` của tiêu đề `striped` được trả lại (`none`/`normal`, để chữ gõ vào không thành chữ hoa); bóng cạnh vùng ghim chỉ vẽ từ hàng tiêu đề (`tr:first-child`), không vẽ lần hai từ hàng lọc; ô gõ giữ chữ của riêng nó, áp dụng sau 400 ms (`FILTER_DELAY`) tính từ phím cuối, ngay khi `Enter`, khi rời ô (bấm nút toán tử cũng là rời ô), `Esc` có chữ thì xoá và áp dụng ngay (phím bị huỷ nên grid không nhận), `Esc` không có chữ là của grid; điều kiện đổi từ bên ngoài thay chữ và bỏ hẹn giờ; `Select` của boolean và lookup có mục đầu `labels.all` (đường về không điều kiện, chữ chờ một mình không cho được) rồi các giá trị (chữ của boolean là `labels.yes`/`labels.no`), giá trị của mục là chỉ số của nó, chọn là áp dụng ngay với `=`; nút toán tử mở một menu duy nhất của grid (`.flg-data-grid-operator-menu`, `MenuPanel` đặt dưới nút), mở ra ở mục đang chọn, chọn là đổi ngay (toán tử không có giá trị vẫn được giữ trong state, chưa lọc gì), focus về nút; mục là [chấm][icon 15px][chữ] (icon nằm trong con của `MenuRadioItem`, Menu không đổi).
   - Chuỗi, số: `Input` cỡ `sm`, khoảng cách 4px, padding trái 3px; ô số căn chữ cuối dòng. +## The filter row
+
+`filterRow` puts a row of cells under the titles, one for each column that filters. It is a row of
+the heading, so it sticks with the titles, and it is a row of the grid for the keyboard (see
+Keyboard). A column whose `allowFiltering` is `false` (the grid's `allowFiltering` is the default)
+has an empty cell there, and so has the column of boxes. Any value of `filterRow` other than `true` is
+`false`.
+
+```tsx
+<DataGrid data={orders} rowKey="id" columns={columns} caption="Orders" filterRow />
+```
+
+**The cells.** A column of text has an input, named `labels.filterCell(caption)` ("Filter Customer"),
+with the button of its operator at the start. A boolean and a column with a `lookup` have a Select with
+no operator: its first item, and its placeholder, is `labels.all` ("(All)"), which takes the condition
+away, and then come the two words of a boolean (`labels.yes` and `labels.no`) or the items of the
+lookup, in its order. The cells of numbers and days come with the next part of the filter row.
+
+**When a condition applies.** What is typed in an input becomes the condition of the column 400 ms after
+the last key. Enter applies it at once (unless an input method is composing), and so does leaving the
+input, which pressing the button of the operator does. A condition that is emptied is taken away. Esc
+in an input that holds text clears it and applies that at once, and the grid does not take the key; Esc
+with no text is the grid's, and goes back to the cell. A choice in a Select applies at once, with
+`=`. A condition that changes from outside (a controlled `filter`, `clearFilter()`) replaces the text
+and drops one that was waiting. Typing draws the input and nothing else. Every change goes through the
+path of every change of the filter: `onFilterChange`, `onStateChange(state, 'filter')`, the first page
+and the rows found (see Filtering).
+
+**The operators.** The button shows the glyph of the operator the column filters by, and is lit while
+the column's condition of the row filters. A press opens the one menu of the grid, under the button,
+with the operators of the column: for text `contains` (the default), `notContains`, `startsWith`,
+`endsWith`, `=` and `<>`. The chosen one is checked and has the focus; a choice applies at once, with
+the text of the cell, and the focus goes back to the button. An operator with no text is kept in the
+state, so the cell shows it, and filters nothing until there is some. A column's `filterOperators`
+narrows the list, in the order of its type, and the first of those is the default. The words come from
+`labels.operators` (a record that you may give in part: the operators you leave out keep their
+English words), the name of the button from `labels.operator(name)` ("Operator: Contains").
+
+**The keys.** The filter row is a row between the titles and the rows: ↑ from the first row goes to it,
+and then to the titles. A cell holds the focus itself, and Enter or F2 goes into its input or its
+Select, not into the operator; Tab goes round the controls of the cell, and Esc or F2 comes back. The
+keys of a column (Enter to sort, resizing, moving, the menu) are the keys of its title alone. In a
+virtual grid the titles are row 1, the filter row row 2 and the first row of data row 3.
+

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-operator-menu.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-operator-menu.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..36c55b6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-operator-menu.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import { createExternalStore, useExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+import type { ExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+
+/**
+ * What the one operator menu of the grid is about: the column, and the button it opens under. `open` is the
+ * only part that goes back and forth: a closed menu keeps its column and its button, so its items stay while
+ * the browser hides it and the focus is given back to the button.
+ */
+export interface OperatorMenuView {
+  readonly open: boolean;
+  readonly columnId: string;
+  readonly from: HTMLElement;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The menu's state, apart from what the rows read: the buttons of the filter cells and the menu read it, so
+ * opening and closing it draws no row and no title (spec phase 6 §3.8). `null` until it is first opened.
+ */
+export type OperatorMenuStore = ExternalStore<OperatorMenuView>;
+
+/** The state of the menu, `null` before it was opened (and on the server). */
+export const useOperatorMenuView = (store: OperatorMenuStore): OperatorMenuView | null =>
+  useExternalStore(store);
+
+export interface OperatorMenuControl {
+  store: OperatorMenuStore;
+  /**
+   * Opens the menu of a column under its button. Asked while it is open, it closes and opens afresh a task
+   * later: the press that asks has already light-dismissed the menu, and the browser reports that a task
+   * later (the column menu's rule).
+   */
+  open: (columnId: string, from: HTMLElement) => void;
+  close: () => void;
+  /** The id of the menu's content, which an open button names in `aria-controls`. */
+  contentId: string;
+}
+
+/** Opening the one operator menu of a grid, under the button of a filter cell (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 F1). */
+export function useOperatorMenu(contentId: string): OperatorMenuControl {
+  const store = useState(() => createExternalStore<OperatorMenuView>())[0];
+  const reopen = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
+
+  const open = useCallback(
+    (columnId: string, from: HTMLElement) => {
+      clearTimeout(reopen.current);
+      const view: OperatorMenuView = { open: true, columnId, from };
+      const now = store.get();
+      if (now?.open) {
+        store.set({ ...now, open: false });
+        reopen.current = setTimeout(() => store.set(view), 0);
+      } else {
+        store.set(view);
+      }
+    },
+    [store],
+  );
+
+  // A close does not cancel a reopening that is waiting: the focus that moves from the menu to the button
+  // of another column ends the menu by a timer of its own, which comes after the close that the reopening
+  // began with.
+  const close = useCallback(() => {
+    const now = store.get();
+    if (now?.open) store.set({ ...now, open: false });
+  }, [store]);
+
+  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(reopen.current), []);
+
+  return useMemo(() => ({ store, open, close, contentId }), [store, open, close, contentId]);
+}

+/** Whether two records of words say the same: the same keys, each with the same value. */
+function sameWords(a: object | undefined, b: object | undefined): boolean {
+  if (a === b) return true;
+  if (!a || !b) return false;
+  const keys = Object.keys(a);
+  return (
+    keys.length === Object.keys(b).length &&
+    keys.every(
+      (key) =>
+        Object.hasOwn(b, key) &&
+        Object.is((a as Record<string, unknown>)[key], (b as Record<string, unknown>)[key]),
+    )
+  );
+}
+

+ * record, compared by its own words (one level deep), so a record written in the JSX is no new labels.

-  const keys = Object.keys(a) as (keyof DataGridLabels)[];
+  const keys = Object.keys(a) as (keyof DataGridLabelsInput)[];

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterCell.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterCell.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b10ead3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterCell.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,181 @@
+import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import type { ChangeEvent, KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
+import { isComposing } from '../../../internal/roving';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import { Input } from '../../input/Input';
+import { Select, SelectItem } from '../../select/Select';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import type { PinPlace } from '../engine/layout';
+import { conditionOf, withRowCondition } from '../engine/filter';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { OperatorButton } from './OperatorButton';
+import { pinAttributes } from './pin-attributes';
+
+/** How long after the last key of a filter cell what was typed is applied, in milliseconds. */
+export const FILTER_DELAY = 400;
+
+/**
+ * The input of a string column (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 F1, §6.3): the operator's button is its start
+ * content. It keeps the text it shows, so a keystroke draws this cell and nothing else; the text goes to the
+ * column's condition `FILTER_DELAY` after the last key, or at once for Enter and when the input is left
+ * (pressing the operator button is leaving it). Esc with text in the input clears it, and that is applied at
+ * once; the key is cancelled, so the grid does not take it, and the next Esc, with no text, is the grid's. A
+ * condition that the filter takes from outside (a controlled parent, `clearFilter()`) replaces the text and
+ * drops a pending one; one the cell sent itself, which a parent may give back later than a newer
+ * keystroke, does not. The operator the user chose stays.
+ */
+function TextFilter<TRow>({ column }: { column: ResolvedColumn<TRow> }) {
+  const { labels } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const { filter, apply } = useFilterView();
+  const value = conditionOf(filter, column.id)?.value;
+  const held = typeof value === 'string' ? value : '';
+  const [text, setText] = useState(held);
+  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
+  // The text that waits for the timer, `null` when none does.
+  const pending = useRef<string | null>(null);
+  // The last text this cell sent or took from the filter: what tells a change from outside from the echo
+  // of one of its own.
+  const known = useRef(held);
+  const latest = useRef(filter);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    latest.current = filter;
+  });
+
+  const drop = useCallback(() => {
+    clearTimeout(timer.current);
+    timer.current = undefined;
+    pending.current = null;
+  }, []);
+  const id = column.id;
+  const send = useCallback(
+    (next: string) => {
+      drop();
+      known.current = next;
+      const operator = conditionOf(latest.current, id)?.operator;
+      apply(withRowCondition(latest.current, id, operator, next));
+    },
+    [apply, drop, id],
+  );
+  const flush = () => {
+    if (pending.current !== null) send(pending.current);
+  };
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (held === known.current) return;
+    known.current = held;
+    drop();
+    setText(held);
+  }, [held, drop]);
+  useEffect(() => drop, [drop]);
+
+  const change = (next: string) => {
+    setText(next);
+    drop();
+    pending.current = next;
+    timer.current = setTimeout(() => send(next), FILTER_DELAY);
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <Input
+      size="sm"
+      autoComplete="off"
+      aria-label={labels.filterCell(column.caption)}
+      startContent={<OperatorButton column={column} />}
+      value={text}
+      onChange={(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => change(event.target.value)}
+      onKeyDown={(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+        // Enter that confirms a candidate of an input method is the method's.
+        if (event.key === 'Enter' && !isComposing(event)) flush();
+        // Esc that clears: not while a method composes, and not with no text, which is the grid's Esc.
+        if (event.key === 'Escape' && !isComposing(event) && text !== '') {
+          event.preventDefault();
+          setText('');
+          send('');
+        }
+      }}
+      onBlur={flush}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+// The value of the "(All)" item: a choice that takes the condition away. The other items' are their indexes.
+const ALL = 'all';
+
+/**
+ * The Select of a boolean and of a lookup (spec phase 6 §4.3 F1, §6.3): no operator, its first item is the
+ * way back to no condition ("(All)", which the placeholder alone does not give). The values of a Select are
+ * strings, so an item's is its index, and the condition holds the item's own value (a lookup's may be a
+ * number). A choice applies at once, with `=`. A held value that no item has shows the placeholder.
+ */
+function ChoiceFilter<TRow>({ column }: { column: ResolvedColumn<TRow> }) {
+  const { labels } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const { filter, apply } = useFilterView();
+  const choices = column.choices ?? [
+    { value: true, text: column.keyText(true) },
+    { value: false, text: column.keyText(false) },
+  ];
+  const value = conditionOf(filter, column.id)?.value;
+  const at = choices.findIndex((choice) => Object.is(choice.value, value));
+  return (
+    <Select
+      size="sm"
+      aria-label={labels.filterCell(column.caption)}
+      placeholder={labels.all}
+      value={at >= 0 ? String(at) : null}
+      onValueChange={(chosen) => {
+        const choice = chosen === ALL ? undefined : choices[Number(chosen)];
+        apply(
+          choice
+            ? withRowCondition(filter, column.id, '=', choice.value)
+            : withRowCondition(filter, column.id, undefined, undefined),
+        );
+      }}
+    >
+      <SelectItem value={ALL}>{labels.all}</SelectItem>
+      {choices.map((choice, index) => (
+        <SelectItem key={index} value={String(index)}>
+          {choice.text}
+        </SelectItem>
+      ))}
+    </Select>
+  );
+}
+
+// What a column draws in its cell: the control of its kind, none for a kind a later task draws.
+function ControlOf<TRow>({ column }: { column: ResolvedColumn<TRow> }) {
+  if (column.choices || column.dataType === 'boolean') return <ChoiceFilter column={column} />;
+  if (column.dataType === 'string') return <TextFilter column={column} />;
+  return null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A cell of the filter row. It is a cell of the grid, the Tab stop when it is the active one, and it holds
+ * its control, which has the focus only after Enter or F2 (the data grid pattern of the APG). A column that
+ * does not filter (`allowFiltering`) and the column of boxes have an empty cell, so the row has as many
+ * cells as the titles.
+ */
+export function FilterCell<TRow>({
+  column,
+  isActive,
+  pin,
+}: {
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>;
+  /** Whether this cell is the active cell, the one Tab stop of the grid. */
+  isActive: boolean;
+  /** Where the cell sticks, if its column is pinned. */
+  pin: PinPlace | undefined;
+}) {
+  const filters = column.service === undefined && column.allowFiltering;
+  return (
+    <td
+      className="flg-table-cell flg-data-grid-filter-cell"
+      tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1}
+      data-align={column.align}
+      data-service={column.service}
+      {...pinAttributes(pin)}
+    >
+      {filters ? <ControlOf column={column} /> : null}
+    </td>
+  );
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterRow.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterRow.tsx
new file mode 100644

+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterRow.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import { memo, useContext } from 'react';
+import { ActiveContext, useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { placeFiller } from './FillerCell';
+import { FilterCell } from './FilterCell';
+
+/**
+ * The filter row (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 F1): the second row of the heading, with a cell for each shown
+ * column, the filler where the titles have it. Memoized like the titles: it takes no prop, so it draws again
+ * only when what the grid shares or the active cell changes. A virtual grid says its place, 2, as the
+ * titles say 1.
+ */
+export const FilterRow = memo(function FilterRow() {
+  const { columns, filler, fillerAt, pins, virtual } = useGridContext();
+  const active = useContext(ActiveContext);
+  return (
+    <tr className="flg-table-row flg-data-grid-filter-row" aria-rowindex={virtual ? 2 : undefined}>
+      {placeFiller(
+        columns.map((column, index) => (
+          <FilterCell
+            key={column.id}
+            column={column}
+            isActive={active?.row === -1 && active.column === index}
+            pin={pins[index]}
+          />
+        )),
+        fillerAt,
+        filler,
+      )}
+    </tr>
+  );
+});

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/OperatorButton.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/OperatorButton.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4c81d81
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/OperatorButton.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { useRef } from 'react';
+import { dataAttr } from '../../../internal/data-attr';
+import { OperatorIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { useTriggerPress } from '../../../internal/use-popover-trigger';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { conditionOf, rowConditionFilters, shownOperator } from '../engine/filter';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { useOperatorMenuView } from '../hooks/use-operator-menu';
+
+/**
+ * The button at the start of a filter cell that opens the one menu of operators (spec phase 6 §4.3 F1):
+ * the glyph of the operator the column filters by, accented while the column's row condition filters
+ * (`rowConditionFilters`, the one answer the funnel and the panel give too). It is a control of its cell,
+ * in the frame of the input: a press on it takes nothing from the input but its focus, which applies what
+ * was typed. A second press on the button of the open menu closes it and does not open it again, which the
+ * click cannot tell by the state alone: the press has light-dismissed the menu before the click arrives
+ * (`useTriggerPress`).
+ */
+export function OperatorButton<TRow>({ column }: { column: ResolvedColumn<TRow> }) {
+  const { labels } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const { filter, operatorMenu } = useFilterView();
+  const view = useOperatorMenuView(operatorMenu.store);
+  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
+  const condition = conditionOf(filter, column.id);
+  const operator = shownOperator(column, condition);
+  const open = view?.open === true && view.columnId === column.id;
+  const press = useTriggerPress(open, (wasOpen) => {
+    if (wasOpen) operatorMenu.close();
+    else if (buttonRef.current) operatorMenu.open(column.id, buttonRef.current);
+  });
+  if (operator === undefined) return null;
+  return (
+    <button
+      ref={buttonRef}
+      type="button"
+      className="flg-data-grid-operator"
+      data-active={dataAttr(rowConditionFilters(column, condition))}
+      aria-label={labels.operator(labels.operators[operator])}
+      aria-haspopup="menu"
+      aria-expanded={open}
+      aria-controls={open ? operatorMenu.contentId : undefined}
+      onPointerDown={press.onPointerDown}
+      onPointerCancel={press.onPointerCancel}
+      onClick={press.onClick}
+    >
+      <OperatorIcon operator={operator} />
+    </button>
+  );
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/OperatorMenu.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/OperatorMenu.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2cb9fed
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/OperatorMenu.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
+import type { MutableRefObject } from 'react';
+import { OperatorIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { MenuTreeContext } from '../../menu/menu-context';
+import type { FocusOnOpen } from '../../menu/menu-context';
+import { MenuRadioGroup, MenuRadioItem } from '../../menu/Menu';
+import { MenuPanel } from '../../menu/MenuPanel';
+import { conditionOf, shownOperator, withRowCondition } from '../engine/filter';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { useOperatorMenuView } from '../hooks/use-operator-menu';
+import type { DataGridFilterOperator } from '../types';
+
+// The focus is put on the checked item here, after the menu shows, and not by the panel, which knows the
+// first and the last item only.
+const NO_FOCUS: MutableRefObject<FocusOnOpen> = { current: 'none' };
+
+/**
+ * The one menu of operators of the grid (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 F1 "Menu toán tử"): the menu of the library
+ * (`MenuPanel`), after the table and outside it so that the name of a cell stays short, under the button of
+ * the filter cell it was opened from. Its items are the operators of that column, each with its glyph before
+ * its words, the one the filter holds checked; it opens on the checked item. A choice is a change of the
+ * filter at once, with the text the cell has applied, and the focus goes back to the button.
+ */
+export function OperatorMenu<TRow>() {
+  const { columns, labels } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const { filter, apply, operatorMenu } = useFilterView();
+  const view = useOperatorMenuView(operatorMenu.store);
+  const tree = useMemo(() => ({ closeAll: operatorMenu.close }), [operatorMenu.close]);
+  const column = view ? columns.find((candidate) => candidate.id === view.columnId) : undefined;
+  const condition = column ? conditionOf(filter, column.id) : undefined;
+  const current = column ? shownOperator(column, condition) : undefined;
+  const panel = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+
+  // Opening: the menu is showing after the commit that opens it (the panel shows it in its own effect, which
+  // runs first), so the checked item can have the focus.
+  const open = view?.open === true;
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!open) return;
+    panel.current
+      ?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitemradio"][aria-checked="true"]')
+      ?.focus({
+        preventScroll: true,
+      });
+  }, [open]);
+
+  const choose = (operator: string): void => {
+    if (!column || operator === current) return;
+    // The held value stays, or none: the cell applied its text when its input was left, which pressing the
+    // button does.
+    apply(
+      withRowCondition(filter, column.id, operator as DataGridFilterOperator, condition?.value),
+    );
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <MenuTreeContext.Provider value={tree}>
+      <MenuPanel
+        ref={panel}
+        className="flg-data-grid-operator-menu"
+        aria-label={column ? labels.filterCell(column.caption) : undefined}
+        open={open}
+        report={(next) => {
+          if (!next) operatorMenu.close();
+        }}
+        contentId={operatorMenu.contentId}
+        reference={() => view?.from ?? null}
+        restoreFocusTo={() => operatorMenu.store.get()?.from ?? null}
+        focusOnOpen={NO_FOCUS}
+        side="bottom"
+        align="start"
+        offset={4}
+      >
+        {column ? (
+          <MenuRadioGroup value={current} onValueChange={choose}>
+            {column.operators.map((operator) => (
+              <MenuRadioItem key={operator} value={operator} textValue={labels.operators[operator]}>
+                <span className="flg-menu-item-icon flg-data-grid-operator-icon" aria-hidden="true">
+                  <OperatorIcon operator={operator} />
+                </span>
+                {labels.operators[operator]}
+              </MenuRadioItem>
+            ))}
+          </MenuRadioGroup>
+        ) : null}
+      </MenuPanel>
+    </MenuTreeContext.Provider>
+  );
+}

+/**
+ * The `labels` a caller passes: any of the labels, and of `operators` any of its words. The record is
+ * merged one level deep, so `{ operators: { contains: 'Chứa' } }` keeps the other operators' defaults.
+ */
+export type DataGridLabelsInput = Partial<Omit<DataGridLabels, 'operators'>> & {
+  operators?: Partial<DataGridLabels['operators']>;
+};
+
 /**

     </svg>

 }
+
+/** The operators of the filter row that `OperatorIcon` draws a glyph for (the grid's `DataGridFilterOperator`). */
+export type OperatorIconName =
+  | 'contains'
+  | 'notContains'
+  | 'startsWith'
+  | 'endsWith'
+  | '='
+  | '<>'
+  | '<'
+  | '>'
+  | '<='
+  | '>='
+  | 'between';
+
+const EQUALS = <path d="M5 9h14M5 15h14" />;
+const CONTAINS = (
+  <>
+    <path d="M21 6H3M10 12H3M10 18H3" />
+    <circle cx="17" cy="15" r="3" />
+    <path d="m21 19-1.9-1.9" />
+  </>
+);
+
+const OPERATOR_GLYPHS: Record<OperatorIconName, ReactNode> = {
+  contains: CONTAINS,
+  notContains: (
+    <>
+      {CONTAINS}
+      <path d="m3 3 18 18" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  startsWith: <path d="M4 5v14M9 9h11M9 15h7" />,
+  endsWith: <path d="M20 5v14M4 9h11M8 15h7" />,
+  '=': EQUALS,
+  '<>': (
+    <>
+      {EQUALS}
+      <path d="M16 4 8 20" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  '<': <path d="m17 6-10 6 10 6" />,
+  '>': <path d="m7 6 10 6-10 6" />,
+  '<=': <path d="m17 4-10 5 10 5M7 19h10" />,
+  '>=': <path d="m7 4 10 5-10 5M7 19h10" />,
+  between: <path d="M4 12h16M4 8v8M20 8v8" />,
+};
+
+/**
+ * The glyph of a filter operator, in the filter row's button and in its menu (spec phase 6 §4.6). An
+ * operator it has no glyph for (a value that came from JavaScript) is an empty icon, never an error.
+ */
+export function OperatorIcon({
+  operator,
+  ...props
+}: SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> & { operator: OperatorIconName }) {
+  return (
+    <svg {...strokeIcon} {...props}>
+      {Object.hasOwn(OPERATOR_GLYPHS, operator) ? OPERATOR_GLYPHS[operator] : null}
+    </svg>
+  );
+}

  - `DataGridLabels` thêm `between` ("From – to"), `from` ("From"), `to` ("To"), `range(from, to)` ("${from} – ${to}"), `ok` ("OK"), `cancel` ("Cancel").
- Nội bộ:
  - `engine/filter.ts`: `formatFilterNumber(value, locale)` (số như locale gõ, không nhóm; `parseFilterNumber` đọc lại), `rangeEnds(column, value)` (cách đọc duy nhất hai đầu của một khoảng; `range()` của engine dùng nó).
  - `hooks/use-anchored-open.ts`: `AnchoredView { open; from }`, `AnchoredOpen<V> { store; open(detail); close() }`, `useAnchoredOpen<V>()`; `hooks/use-operator-menu.ts`: `OperatorMenuView extends AnchoredView` (chữ ký của `OperatorMenuControl` không đổi).
  - `hooks/use-filter-popover.ts`: `FilterPopoverKind = 'between'` (Task 6 thêm `'values'`), `FilterPopoverView { kind; columnId }`, `FilterPopoverStore`, `useFilterPopoverView(store)`, `FilterPopoverControl { store; open(kind, columnId, from); close(); contentId }`, `useFilterPopover(contentId)`.
  - `parts/FilterPopover.tsx`: `ApplyRef` (`applyRef` của nội dung trả `false` để từ chối OK), `FilterPopover`; `parts/BetweenFilter.tsx`: `BetweenFilter({ column })`; `parts/BetweenEditor.tsx`: `BetweenEditor`.
  - `GridContext` thêm `locale`; `FilterView` thêm `popover`.
  - CSS: `.flg-data-grid-filter-number`, `.flg-data-grid-filter-popover`, `.flg-data-grid-filter-popover-footer`; nút lịch trong ô lọc.
- Story: `FilterDates`, `FilterBetween` (`no-visual`).
- Consumes: `parseFilterNumber`, `withRowCondition`, `toFilterKey`, `keyText` (Task 1); `FilterView.apply` (Task 2); `FilterCell`, `OperatorButton`, `OperatorMenu`, `useOperatorMenu` (Task 4); `Input`, `DatePicker`, `Field`, `Button`, `usePopover`, `useFloating`.
- Task sau dùng: Task 6 đặt nội dung `'values'` vào cùng popover và đổi khoảng cách của nó (`PANEL_GAP`); Task 7 thay chữ của ô `between` bằng `rangeText`.

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.filter-ranges.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.filter-ranges.test.tsx

+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridFilter, DataGridProps } from './index';
+import { FILTER_DELAY } from './parts/FilterCell';
+
+// The cells of numbers and days of the filter row, the operator `between` and the one filter popover of the
+// grid (spec phase 6 §4.3 F1 "Hàng lọc", §6.3 "Lọc"). What needs a layout engine or the top layer to be true
+// (the popover under its field, the calendar inside a sticky pinned cell, Esc and the focus after it in each
+// engine) is proven in the stories (`DataGridFiltering.stories.tsx`).
+
+// Which popovers are showing: jsdom has no Popover API.
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  // jsdom's document has no focus once an input is blurred, which a DatePicker would read as a window switch.
+  vi.spyOn(document, 'hasFocus').mockReturnValue(true);
+  showing = new Set();
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => {};
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  qty: number;
+  placed: string;
+  at: number;
+}
+
+// `at` of DH-3 is 6 November 03:30 in Ho Chi Minh City, and 5 November 20:30 in UTC.
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1', qty: 3, placed: '2026-11-04', at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 4, 9, 0) },
+  { id: 'DH-2', qty: 12, placed: '2026-11-05', at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 9, 0) },
+  { id: 'DH-3', qty: 21, placed: '2026-11-06', at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 20, 30) },
+  { id: 'DH-4', qty: 1000.5, placed: '2026-11-07', at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 7, 9, 0) },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 104, allowFiltering: false },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 100 },
+  { field: 'placed', caption: 'Placed', dataType: 'date', width: 150 },
+  { field: 'at', caption: 'At', dataType: 'datetime', width: 170 },
+];
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      filterRow
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+/** A grid whose parent holds the filter, as the parent of a controlled grid does. */
+function Held({
+  start = {},
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & { start?: DataGridFilter }) {
+  const [filter, setFilter] = useState(start);
+  return (
+    <>
+      <button type="button" onClick={() => setFilter({ columns: { qty: { value: 21 } } })}>
+        set outside
+      </button>
+      <Orders filter={filter} onFilterChange={setFilter} {...props} />
+    </>
+  );
+}
+
+const grid = () => screen.getByRole('grid') as HTMLTableElement;
+const bodyRows = () => Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('tbody > tr'));
+const ids = () => bodyRows().map((row) => row.children[0]!.textContent);
+const qty = () => screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Filter Qty' }) as HTMLInputElement;
+const placed = () => screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Filter Placed' }) as HTMLInputElement;
+const at = () => screen.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Filter At' }) as HTMLInputElement;
+const range = () => screen.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Filter Qty' }) as HTMLInputElement;
+// Three columns have an operator button and the same default operator: a test names the cell it means when it matters.
+const operatorButton = (name: string, cell: HTMLElement = document.body) =>
+  within(cell).getByRole('button', { name: `Operator: ${name}` }) as HTMLButtonElement;
+const menu = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-operator-menu');
+const radio = (name: string) =>
+  Array.from(menu()?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitemradio"]') ?? []).find(
+    (item) => item.textContent === name,
+  )!;
+const popovers = () => document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-filter-popover');
+const popover = () => popovers()[0]!;
+// jsdom takes a popover for hidden, as it does a Select's listbox: its parts are found by role all the same.
+const inPopover = (role: string, name: string) =>
+  within(popover()).getByRole(role, { name, hidden: true });
+const editor = (name: string) => inPopover('textbox', name) as HTMLInputElement;
+const button = (name: string) => inPopover('button', name);
+const advance = (ms: number) => act(() => void vi.advanceTimersByTime(ms));
+const lastFilter = (spy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>) => spy.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0];
+const type = (element: HTMLElement, text: string) =>
+  fireEvent.change(element, { target: { value: text } });
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, key: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, { key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...init });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+/** A press and a click on an element, as a mouse makes them. */
+function click(element: HTMLElement) {
+  fireEvent.pointerDown(element, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1 });
+  fireEvent.mouseDown(element);
+  fireEvent.pointerUp(element, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 0 });
+  fireEvent.click(element, { detail: 1 });
+}
+const leave = (element: HTMLElement) =>
+  act(() => {
+    element.focus();
+    element.blur();
+  });
+const aTaskLater = () => act(() => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0)));
+const chooseOperator = (from: string, to: string, cell: HTMLElement = document.body) => {
+  click(operatorButton(from, cell));
+  act(() => radio(to).click());
+};
+

+  it('reads the number as the locale writes it: 1,000.5 in en-US and 1.000,5 in vi-VN', () => {

+    expect(qty()).not.toBeInvalid();
+    expect(lastFilter(onFilterChange)).toEqual({ columns: { qty: { value: 21 } } });
+    expect(onFilterChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);

+
+  it('applies nothing for text that is no number when the column had no condition', () => {

+ * (the operator's button 20px at the start of the field, the calendar's button 20px with a glyph of 14px at
+ * the end), a typed day that applies on Enter, the calendar that opens under the field of the pinned cell
+ * with the frame scrolled sideways and scrolls neither the page nor the frame, its keys that stay in it (the

+    await expect(placed.top - under.bottom, 'close under the field').toBeLessThan(32);
+    await expect(placed.bottom).toBeLessThanOrEqual(window.innerHeight);
+    await expect(placed.width).toBe(216);
+    await expect(scrollsOf(frame)).toEqual(before);
+    await expect(stops()).toEqual([cell]);
+
+    // Esc closes it and changes nothing; the focus is back on the field.
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(), 'the popover is closed').toBe(false), POPUP_SHOWN);
+    await expect(field).toHaveFocus();
+    await expect(args.onFilterChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    await expect(dataRowsOf(root)).toHaveLength(unfiltered);
+
+    // Tab past the last control closes it as Cancel, and so does Shift+Tab before the first.
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(), 'the popover is open').toBe(true), POPUP_SHOWN);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(end('From'), 'the first end has the focus').toHaveFocus(),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await real.keyboard('{Tab}');
+    await expect(end('To')).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{Tab}{Tab}');
+    await expect(within(popover()).getByRole('button', { name: 'OK' })).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{Tab}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(), 'the popover is closed').toBe(false), POPUP_SHOWN);
+    await expect(field).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(end('From'), 'the first end has the focus').toHaveFocus(),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await real.keyboard('{Shift>}{Tab}{/Shift}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(), 'the popover is closed').toBe(false), POPUP_SHOWN);
+    await expect(field).toHaveFocus();
+    await expect(args.onFilterChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+
+    // Both ends typed, Enter applies: the rows between them, ends included, and the field says the range.
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(end('From'), 'the first end has the focus').toHaveFocus(),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await real.keyboard('5{Tab}9{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => {
+      expect(args.onFilterChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(isOpen(), 'the popover is closed').toBe(false);
+      expect(dataRowsOf(root), 'the rows are those between').toHaveLength(
+        SALES.filter((sale) => sale.qty >= 5 && sale.qty <= 9).length,
+      );
+    }, FILTER_APPLIED);
+    await expect(args.onFilterChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({
+      columns: { qty: { operator: 'between', value: [5, 9] } },
+    });
+    await expect(field).toHaveValue('5 – 9');
+    await expect(field).toHaveFocus();
+    await expect(cell.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-operator')).toHaveAttribute('data-active');
+    // The keys of the grid are the grid's again.
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await expect(cell).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard(`{${mod}>}{Home}{/${mod}}`);
+    await expect(dataRowsOf(root)[0]!.firstElementChild).toHaveFocus();
+  },
+};

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-anchored-open.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-anchored-open.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ec55134
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-anchored-open.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import { createExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+import type { ExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+
+/**
+ * What a popup that the grid keeps one of is about: whether it shows, and the element it opens under.
+ * `open` is the only part that goes back and forth: a closed popup keeps what it was about, so its content
+ * stays while the browser hides it and the focus is given back to the element it opened from.
+ */
+export interface AnchoredView {
+  readonly open: boolean;
+  readonly from: HTMLElement;
+}
+
+export interface AnchoredOpen<V extends AnchoredView> {
+  store: ExternalStore<V>;
+  /**
+   * Opens the popup for `detail`, under `detail.from`. Asked while it is open, it closes and opens afresh
+   * a task later: the press that asks has already light-dismissed the popup, and the browser reports that
+   * a task later (the column menu's rule).
+   */
+  open: (detail: Omit<V, 'open'>) => void;
+  close: () => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The state of a popup that the grid keeps one of (the menu of operators, the filter popover), apart from
+ * what the rows read: the parts that open it and the popup read it, so opening and closing it draws no row
+ * and no title (spec phase 6 §3.8). The store is `null` until the popup is first opened.
+ */
+export function useAnchoredOpen<V extends AnchoredView>(): AnchoredOpen<V> {
+  const store = useState(() => createExternalStore<V>())[0];
+  const reopen = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
+
+  const open = useCallback(
+    (detail: Omit<V, 'open'>) => {
+      clearTimeout(reopen.current);
+      const view = { ...detail, open: true } as V;
+      const now = store.get();
+      if (now?.open) {
+        store.set({ ...now, open: false });
+        reopen.current = setTimeout(() => store.set(view), 0);
+      } else {
+        store.set(view);
+      }
+    },
+    [store],
+  );
+
+  // A close does not cancel a reopening that is waiting: the focus that moves from the popup to the opener
+  // of another column ends the popup by a timer of its own, which comes after the close that the reopening
+  // began with.
+  const close = useCallback(() => {
+    const now = store.get();
+    if (now?.open) store.set({ ...now, open: false });
+  }, [store]);
+
+  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(reopen.current), []);
+
+  return useMemo(() => ({ store, open, close }), [store, open, close]);
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-filter-popover.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-filter-popover.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..05e7603
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-filter-popover.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
+import { useAnchoredOpen } from './use-anchored-open';
+import type { AnchoredView } from './use-anchored-open';
+import { useExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+import type { ExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+
+/**
+ * What the one filter popover of the grid holds: the two ends of a range (`between`). The header filter's
+ * list of values is its second kind.
+ */
+export type FilterPopoverKind = 'between';
+
+/**
+ * What the one filter popover of the grid is about: its kind, the column, and the element it opens under
+ * and gives the focus back to (see `AnchoredView`).
+ */
+export interface FilterPopoverView extends AnchoredView {
+  readonly kind: FilterPopoverKind;
+  readonly columnId: string;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The popover's state, apart from what the rows read: what opens it and the popover read it, so opening
+ * and closing it draws no row and no title (spec phase 6 §3.8). `null` until it is first opened.
+ */
+export type FilterPopoverStore = ExternalStore<FilterPopoverView>;
+
+/** The state of the popover, `null` before it was opened (and on the server). */
+export const useFilterPopoverView = (store: FilterPopoverStore): FilterPopoverView | null =>
+  useExternalStore(store);
+
+export interface FilterPopoverControl {
+  store: FilterPopoverStore;
+  /** Opens the popover of a kind for a column, under `from` (and afresh, a task later, when it is open). */
+  open: (kind: FilterPopoverKind, columnId: string, from: HTMLElement) => void;
+  close: () => void;
+  /** The id of the popover, which an open opener names in `aria-controls`. */
+  contentId: string;
+}
+
+/** Opening the one filter popover of a grid (spec phase 6 §3.6, §6.3 "Lọc ở header"). */
+export function useFilterPopover(contentId: string): FilterPopoverControl {
+  const { store, open: openAnchored, close } = useAnchoredOpen<FilterPopoverView>();
+  const open = useCallback(
+    (kind: FilterPopoverKind, columnId: string, from: HTMLElement) =>
+      openAnchored({ kind, columnId, from }),
+    [openAnchored],
+  );
+  return useMemo(() => ({ store, open, close, contentId }), [store, open, close, contentId]);
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/BetweenEditor.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/BetweenEditor.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f612904
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/BetweenEditor.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import { DatePicker } from '../../date-picker/DatePicker';
+import { Field } from '../../field/Field';
+import { Input } from '../../input/Input';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import {
+  conditionOf,
+  formatFilterNumber,
+  parseFilterNumber,
+  rangeEnds,
+  withRowCondition,
+} from '../engine/filter';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import type { ApplyRef } from './FilterPopover';
+
+// An end as the editor holds it: the text of a number, as the user types it, or the ISO day of a date; `''`
+// for an open end.
+type End = string;
+
+// An end of the range as it goes to the filter: a number or a day, `undefined` for an open end, `null` for
+// text that is no number (which the editor cannot apply).
+const endOf = (text: End, numeric: boolean, locale: string): number | string | null | undefined => {
+  if (text.trim() === '') return undefined;
+  return numeric ? parseFilterNumber(text, locale) : text;
+};
+
+/**
+ * The content of the filter popover for a range (`between`) of numbers or days (spec phase 6 §6.3, outside
+ * the mockup): two fields, "From" and "To", each with the editor of the column's type, a number `Input` or a
+ * `DatePicker`; they start from the ends the condition holds. It gives its OK to the popover through
+ * `applyRef`: both ends go to the condition as `[from, to]`, an empty end is `null` and open, both empty is no
+ * value (the operator stays). A number that cannot be read is marked `invalid` and OK cannot apply it: it
+ * answers `false`, so the popover stays open with the focus on that field.
+ */
+export function BetweenEditor<TRow>({
+  column,
+  applyRef,
+}: {
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>;
+  applyRef: ApplyRef;
+}) {
+  const { labels, locale } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const { filter, apply } = useFilterView();
+  const numeric = column.dataType === 'number';
+  const [start, finish] = rangeEnds(column, conditionOf(filter, column.id)?.value);
+  const shown = (end: number | string | undefined): End =>
+    typeof end === 'number' ? formatFilterNumber(end, locale) : (end ?? '');
+  const [from, setFrom] = useState<End>(() => shown(start));
+  const [to, setTo] = useState<End>(() => shown(finish));
+  const fromRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
+  const toRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
+
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    applyRef.current = () => {
+      const ends = [endOf(from, numeric, locale), endOf(to, numeric, locale)];
+      const bad = ends.findIndex((end) => end === null);
+      if (bad >= 0) {
+        (bad === 0 ? fromRef : toRef).current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
+        return false;
+      }
+      const open = ends.every((end) => end === undefined);
+      apply(
+        withRowCondition(
+          filter,
+          column.id,
+          'between',
+          open ? undefined : ends.map((end) => end ?? null),
+        ),
+      );
+      return true;
+    };
+  });
+  // The popover draws its content only while it is open: what it may ask of this editor goes with it.
+  useEffect(
+    () => () => {
+      applyRef.current = undefined;
+    },
+    [applyRef],
+  );
+
+  const fields: [string, End, (next: End) => void, typeof fromRef][] = [
+    [labels.from, from, setFrom, fromRef],
+    [labels.to, to, setTo, toRef],
+  ];
+  return (
+    <>
+      {fields.map(([label, text, set, ref]) => (
+        <Field key={label} label={label}>
+          {numeric ? (
+            <Input
+              ref={ref}
+              size="sm"
+              autoComplete="off"
+              inputMode="decimal"
+              className="flg-data-grid-filter-number"
+              invalid={text.trim() !== '' && endOf(text, true, locale) === null ? true : undefined}
+              value={text}
+              onChange={(event) => set(event.target.value)}
+            />
+          ) : (
+            <DatePicker
+              ref={ref}
+              size="sm"
+              locale={locale}
+              value={text === '' ? null : text}
+              onValueChange={(next) => set(next ?? '')}
+            />
+          )}
+        </Field>
+      ))}
+    </>
+  );
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0f666fe
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/BetweenFilter.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+import { useRef } from 'react';
+import type { KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
+import { hasModifier, isComposing } from '../../../internal/roving';
+import { useTriggerPress } from '../../../internal/use-popover-trigger';
+import { Input } from '../../input/Input';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { conditionOf, rangeEnds, rowConditionFilters } from '../engine/filter';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { useFilterPopoverView } from '../hooks/use-filter-popover';
+import { OperatorButton } from './OperatorButton';
+
+/**
+ * The cell of a number or a day whose operator is `between` (spec phase 6 §4.3 F1 "Trong khoảng", outside
+ * the mockup): a read-only field that says the range, `labels.range(from, to)` with each end written as the
+ * column writes it (an open end is empty), or the placeholder `labels.between` while there is none. A press,
+ * or Enter, opens the one filter popover of the grid, where the two ends are edited; a second press on the
+ * field of the open popover closes it and does not open it again (`useTriggerPress`). The field is the
+ * popover's opener, the element it gives the focus back to, so it is a combobox with a dialog for a popup.
+ */
+export function BetweenFilter<TRow>({ column }: { column: ResolvedColumn<TRow> }) {
+  const { labels } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const { filter, popover } = useFilterView();
+  const view = useFilterPopoverView(popover.store);
+  const fieldRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
+  const condition = conditionOf(filter, column.id);
+  const open = view?.open === true && view.columnId === column.id && view.kind === 'between';
+  const show = () => {
+    if (fieldRef.current) popover.open('between', column.id, fieldRef.current);
+  };
+  const press = useTriggerPress(open, (wasOpen) => {
+    if (wasOpen) popover.close();
+    else show();
+  });
+  let text = '';
+  if (rowConditionFilters(column, condition)) {
+    const [from, to] = rangeEnds(column, condition?.value);
+    const write = (end: number | string | undefined) =>
+      end === undefined ? '' : column.keyText(end);
+    text = labels.range(write(from), write(to));
+  }
+  return (
+    <Input
+      ref={fieldRef}
+      size="sm"
+      readOnly
+      role="combobox"
+      className={column.dataType === 'number' ? 'flg-data-grid-filter-number' : undefined}
+      aria-label={labels.filterCell(column.caption)}
+      aria-haspopup="dialog"
+      aria-expanded={open}
+      aria-controls={open ? popover.contentId : undefined}
+      placeholder={labels.between}
+      startContent={<OperatorButton column={column} />}
+      value={text}
+      onPointerDown={press.onPointerDown}
+      onPointerCancel={press.onPointerCancel}
+      onClick={press.onClick}
+      onKeyDown={(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+        if (event.key !== 'Enter' || hasModifier(event) || isComposing(event)) return;
+        event.preventDefault();
+        show();
+      }}
+    />
+  );
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterPopover.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterPopover.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..96bd4b3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterPopover.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,135 @@
+import { useRef } from 'react';
+import type { KeyboardEvent, MutableRefObject } from 'react';
+import { POPUP_SELECTOR } from '../../../internal/controls';
+import { focusFirst, getFocusables } from '../../../internal/focus';
+import { hasModifier, isComposing } from '../../../internal/roving';
+import { useFloating } from '../../../internal/use-floating';
+import { usePopover } from '../../../internal/use-popover';
+import { usePopoverState } from '../../../internal/use-popover-trigger';
+import { Button } from '../../button/Button';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { useFilterPopoverView } from '../hooks/use-filter-popover';
+import { BetweenEditor } from './BetweenEditor';
+
+/**
+ * What the content of the popover does when the user means OK: it applies what it holds to the filter and
+ * answers whether the popover may close (`false` for what it cannot apply, such as text in a range's end that
+ * is no number). The content writes it, the popover's keys and its OK button call it.
+ */
+export type ApplyRef = MutableRefObject<(() => boolean) | undefined>;
+
+/** Extra distance that makes room for the arrow, in px (the Popover's). */
+const ARROW_SPACE = 10;
+
+/** The gap between the opener and the arrow of the popover, in px (the Popover's default). */
+const SIDE_OFFSET = 8;
+
+/**
+ * The one filter popover of the grid (spec phase 6 §3.6, §6.3): the glass `Popover` of the library, with its
+ * arrow, `role="dialog"`, opened under the element a cell asks (the range of `between`), which it gives the
+ * focus back to. It is after the table and outside it, so keys and presses in it are not the grid's. The
+ * focus goes to its first control when it opens. Enter (not on a button) is OK and Esc is Cancel, which is
+ * the browser's own close; Tab past the last control and Shift+Tab before the first close it as Cancel does
+ * and give the focus back to what opened it; a light dismiss is a Cancel too. It draws its content only while
+ * it is open, so each opening starts from the filter as it is.
+ */
+export function FilterPopover<TRow>() {
+  const { columns, labels } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const { popover } = useFilterView();
+  const view = useFilterPopoverView(popover.store);
+  const column = view ? columns.find((candidate) => candidate.id === view.columnId) : undefined;
+  const open = view?.open === true && column !== undefined;
+  const arrowRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
+  const applyRef: ApplyRef = useRef(undefined);
+
+  const state = usePopoverState<HTMLDivElement>({
+    open,
+    defaultOpen: false,
+    onOpenChange: (next) => {
+      if (!next) popover.close();
+    },
+    name: 'DataGrid filter popover',
+  });
+  const { contentRef } = state;
+  usePopover(contentRef, {
+    open,
+    onOpenChange: state.report,
+    pendingToggle: state.pendingToggle,
+    restoreFocusTo: () => popover.store.get()?.from ?? null,
+    onShown: () => {
+      if (contentRef.current) focusFirst(contentRef.current);
+    },
+  });
+  useFloating({
+    open,
+    // Under the field, whose frame is wider than its input.
+    reference: () => view?.from.closest('.flg-input') ?? view?.from ?? null,
+    floating: contentRef,
+    side: 'bottom',
+    align: 'start',
+    offset: SIDE_OFFSET + ARROW_SPACE,
+    arrow: arrowRef,
+  });
+
+  // OK applies and closes, unless the content cannot apply what it holds. Cancel closes and changes nothing.
+  const ok = () => {
+    if (applyRef.current?.() !== false) popover.close();
+  };
+  const cancel = () => popover.close();
+
+  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
+    const dialog = contentRef.current;
+    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
+    // Keys of a popup inside it (a calendar) are its own, and so are those of an input method.
+    if (!dialog || target.closest(POPUP_SELECTOR) !== dialog || isComposing(event)) return;
+    if (event.key === 'Enter' && !hasModifier(event)) {
+      // A button presses itself, and a control that has refused the key (a date that cannot be read) keeps it.
+      if (event.defaultPrevented || target.closest('button')) return;
+      event.preventDefault();
+      // A control that took this very key (a DatePicker that reads its text) has told the editor in this event,
+      // whose render is flushed when the event ends: OK reads what the editor holds then, not before.
+      queueMicrotask(ok);
+    } else if (event.key === 'Tab' && !event.ctrlKey && !event.altKey && !event.metaKey) {
+      const stops = getFocusables(dialog).filter((el) => el.closest(POPUP_SELECTOR) === dialog);
+      const edge = event.shiftKey ? stops[0] : stops.at(-1);
+      if (edge !== target) return;
+      // The popover is after the table: Tab would leave from the end of the grid's own controls. It closes
+      // as Cancel does, and the focus goes back to what opened it.
+      event.preventDefault();
+      cancel();
+    }
+  };
+
+  return (
+    // The keys are those of the controls inside it, which have their own; the popover only reads Enter and Tab.
+    // eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions
+    <div
+      ref={contentRef}
+      popover="auto"
+      role="dialog"
+      tabIndex={-1}
+      id={popover.contentId}
+      aria-label={column ? labels.filterCell(column.caption) : undefined}
+      data-side="bottom"
+      data-align="start"
+      className="flg-surface flg-popover flg-data-grid-filter-popover"
+      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
+    >
+      {open && column ? (
+        <>
+          <span ref={arrowRef} className="flg-popover-arrow" aria-hidden="true" />
+          <BetweenEditor column={column} applyRef={applyRef} />
+          <div className="flg-data-grid-filter-popover-footer">
+            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={cancel}>
+              {labels.cancel}
+            </Button>
+            <Button variant="primary" size="sm" onClick={ok}>
+              {labels.ok}
+            </Button>
+          </div>
+        </>
+      ) : null}
+    </div>
+  );
+}
