diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.header-filter.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.header-filter.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5c7ff99
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.header-filter.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,747 @@
+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridFilter, DataGridProps } from './index';
+
+// The header filter (spec phase 6 §4.3 G1 "Nút biểu tượng", F1 "Popover lọc ở header", §6.3 "Lọc ở header"): the
+// funnel on a title, the list of distinct values in the one filter popover of the grid, and the rule of its OK.
+// What needs a layout engine or the top layer to be true (the popover under its funnel, the focus after it in
+// each engine, nothing scrolling) is proven in the stories (`DataGridFiltering.stories.tsx`).
+
+// Which popovers are showing: jsdom has no Popover API.
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  showing = new Set();
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => {};
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  status: string;
+  channel: string | null;
+  qty: number;
+}
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1', customer: 'An', status: 'New', channel: 'Store', qty: 3 },
+  { id: 'DH-2', customer: 'Binh', status: 'Processing', channel: 'Website', qty: 12 },
+  { id: 'DH-3', customer: 'An', status: 'Processing', channel: 'Store', qty: 21 },
+  { id: 'DH-4', customer: 'Cuong', status: 'Delivered', channel: null, qty: 4 },
+  { id: 'DH-5', customer: 'Dung', status: 'Cancelled', channel: 'Phone', qty: 8 },
+  { id: 'DH-6', customer: 'Binh', status: 'New', channel: 'Website', qty: 30 },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 104, allowHeaderFiltering: false },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 160 },
+  { field: 'status', caption: 'Status', width: 140 },
+  { field: 'channel', caption: 'Channel', width: 140 },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 100 },
+];
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      headerFilter
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const grid = () => screen.getByRole('grid') as HTMLTableElement;
+const ids = () =>
+  Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('tbody > tr')).map(
+    (row) => row.children[0]!.textContent,
+  );
+const funnel = (caption: string, active = false) =>
+  screen.getByRole('button', {
+    name: active ? `Filter ${caption} (filtered)` : `Filter ${caption}`,
+  });
+const funnels = () =>
+  Array.from(
+    grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-head-button[aria-haspopup="dialog"]'),
+  );
+const names = (buttons: Iterable<Element>) =>
+  Array.from(buttons).map((el) => el.getAttribute('aria-label'));
+const titleOf = (caption: string) =>
+  within(grid()).getByRole('columnheader', { name: new RegExp(caption) });
+const popover = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-filter-popover')!;
+const inPopover = (role: string, name: string) =>
+  within(popover()).getByRole(role, { name, hidden: true });
+const search = () => inPopover('searchbox', 'Search values') as HTMLInputElement;
+const box = (name: string) => inPopover('checkbox', name) as HTMLInputElement;
+const button = (name: string) => inPopover('button', name);
+const inputs = () =>
+  Array.from(popover().querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('.flg-data-grid-value-list input'));
+// The list as it is drawn: each line's text, and the lines that are checked.
+const lines = () =>
+  Array.from(
+    popover().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-value-list .flg-checkbox'),
+  ).map((label) => label.textContent);
+const checkedLines = () =>
+  inputs()
+    .filter((input) => input.checked)
+    .map((input) => input.closest('label')!.textContent);
+const type = (element: HTMLElement, text: string) =>
+  fireEvent.change(element, { target: { value: text } });
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, key: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, { key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...init });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+/** A press and a click on an element, as a mouse makes them. */
+function click(element: HTMLElement) {
+  fireEvent.pointerDown(element, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1 });
+  fireEvent.mouseDown(element);
+  fireEvent.pointerUp(element, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 0 });
+  fireEvent.click(element, { detail: 1 });
+}
+const aTaskLater = () => act(() => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0)));
+const lastFilter = (spy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>) => spy.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0] as DataGridFilter;
+// What the browser does when it closes a popover itself (a press elsewhere, Esc): it tells the page with a toggle.
+const dismiss = () =>
+  act(() => {
+    showing.delete(popover());
+    fireEvent(popover(), Object.assign(new Event('toggle'), { newState: 'closed' }));
+  });

+  it('is filled for a header condition that filters, and for no other', () => {

+  it('comes after the sort button and before the column menu, which F2 on the title goes through', () => {

+describe('OK', () => {

+describe('Cancel, Esc and a light dismiss', () => {

+    Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');

+## The header filter
+
+`headerFilter` puts a funnel on the title of each column that has one: it opens a list of the values
+that the column holds, each with a box, and what is checked is kept. A column whose
+`allowHeaderFiltering` is `false` has no funnel (the grid's `allowHeaderFiltering` is the default,
+`true`), and neither has the column of boxes. Any value of `headerFilter` other than `true` is
+`false`. It is a button of the title, after the sort button and before the one of the column menu,
+and it is always drawn. It is filled while the column has a condition of its header filter, and a
+condition of the filter row does not fill it. Its name is `labels.filterColumn(caption, active)`.
+
+```tsx
+<DataGrid data={orders} rowKey="id" columns={columns} caption="Orders" headerFilter />
+```
+
+**The list.** The popover is the one popover of the grid, the glass popover of the library with its arrow,
+a `dialog` named `labels.filterColumn(caption, false)`, drawn after the table and only while it is open,
+under the funnel and centred on it, 216px wide. It holds a search field (`labels.searchValues`), the
+list, and `labels.cancel` and `labels.ok`. The list has `labels.selectAllValues` first, which checks
+what the search shows, then the values of the column as the column writes them and in the order the
+column sorts, and `labels.blank` last when a row is blank. Nine values show; the list scrolls after
+that, and past 500 values only the first 500 are drawn, with a line, `labels.moreValues(shown,
+total)`, to say so: search to narrow them. The search narrows the list at once, whatever the case or
+the accents.
+
+The values are those of the rows that the search of the grid and the conditions of the other columns
+keep, so each list is narrowed by what is already filtered, with the values that the column's own
+condition names added. A column's own conditions do not narrow its own list. The list is read when the
+popover opens, and it does not change while the popover is open.
+
+**OK.** The boxes start from the column's condition, all checked when it has none. OK stores what is
+checked as the header condition: every value checked is no condition, more than half checked is
+`exclude` with the values that are not checked, and the others are `values` with the ones that are.
+Nothing checked is a condition that keeps no row, and not a change that is left out. The condition of the
+filter row of the column stays, and the two are joined by "and". OK calls `onFilterChange` once, goes
+to the first page and says the rows found. Cancel, Esc and a press elsewhere close the popover and
+change nothing, and an OK that changes nothing calls nothing.
+
+**The keys.** Enter on the funnel opens it, with the focus in the search field. ↓ in the search field
+goes into the list, which is one stop of Tab: ↑ and ↓ move among its boxes, Home and End go to the
+first and the last, and Space checks. Enter, but not on a button, is OK. Tab past OK and Shift+Tab before
+the search field close the popover as Cancel does and give the focus back to the funnel. A second press
+on the funnel of the open popover closes it, and a press on the funnel of another title moves the popover
+there. Opening it scrolls neither the page nor the frame. F2 on a title goes into its controls in the
+order of the title: the sort button, the funnel, the menu.
+
+**Server mode.** With `remote` the grid cannot know the values of the rows it has not got, so the list is
+the column's `headerFilter.values`, in its order, each with its `value` and its `text`. A column that
+allows header filtering and has none lists the values of the page and warns once.
+
+```tsx
+const columns = [
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    caption: 'Status',
+    headerFilter: {
+      values: [
+        { value: 'new', text: 'New' },
+        { value: 'processing', text: 'Processing' },
+      ],
+    },
+  },
+];
+```

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/FunnelButton.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FunnelButton.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a8b835c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FunnelButton.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+import { useRef } from 'react';
+import { dataAttr } from '../../../internal/data-attr';
+import { FunnelIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { useTriggerPress } from '../../../internal/use-popover-trigger';
+import { conditionOf, headerConditionFilters } from '../engine/filter';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { pressTitle } from '../grid-dom';
+import { useFilterPopoverView } from '../hooks/use-filter-popover';
+
+/**
+ * The funnel on a title that opens the header filter of its column (spec phase 6 §4.3 G1, F1): the
+ * column's distinct values, in the one filter popover of the grid. It is filled (`data-active`) while the
+ * column has a header condition that filters (`headerConditionFilters`, the one answer the filter bar gives
+ * too); a condition of the filter row is the operator button's sign and not this one's. It reads the
+ * popover's state apart from what the rows read, so opening it draws this button and no title, row or
+ * toolbar.
+ *
+ * A press on it is a press on the title, which is where the focus goes: the `mousedown` is cancelled and
+ * the title focused, as the sort button does; the click opens the popover. A second press on the funnel of
+ * the open popover closes it and does not open it again, which the click cannot tell by the state alone: the
+ * press has light-dismissed the popover before the click arrives (`useTriggerPress`).
+ */
+export function FunnelButton({ columnId, caption }: { columnId: string; caption: string }) {
+  const { labels } = useGridContext();
+  const { filter, popover } = useFilterView();
+  const view = useFilterPopoverView(popover.store);
+  const open = view?.open === true && view.kind === 'values' && view.columnId === columnId;
+  const active = headerConditionFilters(conditionOf(filter, columnId));
+  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
+  const press = useTriggerPress(open, (wasOpen) => {
+    if (wasOpen) popover.close();
+    else if (buttonRef.current) popover.open('values', columnId, buttonRef.current);
+  });
+  return (
+    <button
+      ref={buttonRef}
+      type="button"
+      className="flg-data-grid-head-button"
+      data-active={dataAttr(active)}
+      aria-label={labels.filterColumn(caption, active)}
+      aria-haspopup="dialog"
+      aria-expanded={open}
+      aria-controls={open ? popover.contentId : undefined}
+      onPointerDown={press.onPointerDown}
+      onPointerCancel={press.onPointerCancel}
+      onMouseDown={pressTitle}
+      onClick={press.onClick}
+    >
+      <FunnelIcon />
+    </button>
+  );
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/HeaderFilter.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/HeaderFilter.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..372c300
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/HeaderFilter.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,173 @@
+import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import type { FocusEvent, KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
+import { focusNext, hasModifier, isComposing } from '../../../internal/roving';
+import { includesFolded } from '../../../internal/text-fold';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import { Checkbox } from '../../checkbox/Checkbox';
+import { Divider } from '../../divider/Divider';
+import { SearchField } from '../../search-field/SearchField';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import {
+  DISTINCT_LIMIT,
+  conditionOf,
+  headerConditionFilters,
+  headerSelection,
+  withHeaderCondition,
+} from '../engine/filter';
+import type { DistinctItem } from '../engine/filter';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import type { ApplyRef } from './FilterPopover';
+
+// What a value is told apart by in a list: its type and its text, so the number 1 and the text "1" differ and
+// the blank (`null`) has a key of its own.
+const keyOf = (value: unknown): string => `${typeof value}:${String(value)}`;
+
+// The keys that start out checked: all of them when the column has no header condition, else the ones the
+// condition keeps (`exclude` keeps every value but its own).
+function startChecked(
+  items: readonly DistinctItem[],
+  values: readonly unknown[] | undefined,
+  exclude: boolean,
+) {
+  if (values === undefined) return new Set(items.map((item) => item.value));
+  const named = new Set<unknown>(values.map((value) => value ?? null));
+  return new Set(
+    items.filter((item) => named.has(item.value) !== exclude).map((item) => item.value),
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The content of the filter popover for the header filter of a column (spec phase 6 §4.3 F1 "Popover lọc ở
+ * header", §6.3 "Lọc ở header"): a search field and the column's distinct values, each with a box, "(Select
+ * all)" first and "(Blanks)" last. The list is read once, when the popover opens (`listValues`: the rows after
+ * the search and the conditions of the other columns, with the values the condition names), and the boxes
+ * start from the column's header condition, all checked when there is none. The search narrows what is drawn
+ * as it is typed, by `includesFolded`, and "(Select all)" checks, or clears, the values it shows. At most
+ * `DISTINCT_LIMIT` are drawn; a line says how many more match. The list is one stop of Tab and its boxes
+ * rove with the arrow keys, Home and End; ↓ in the search field goes into it.
+ *
+ * It gives its OK to the popover through `applyRef`: what is checked goes to the column's header condition
+ * (`headerSelection`: all is no condition, more than half is `exclude`, none keeps no row), and the column's
+ * row condition stays, joined to it by "and".
+ */
+export function HeaderFilter<TRow>({
+  column,
+  applyRef,
+}: {
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>;
+  applyRef: ApplyRef;
+}) {
+  const { labels } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const { filter, apply, listValues } = useFilterView();
+  const [items] = useState(() => listValues(column.id));
+  const [checked, setChecked] = useState<ReadonlySet<unknown>>(() => {
+    const condition = conditionOf(filter, column.id);
+    return headerConditionFilters(condition)
+      ? startChecked(items, condition?.values, condition?.exclude === true)
+      : startChecked(items, undefined, false);
+  });
+  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
+  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
+  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+
+  const textOf = (item: DistinctItem) => (item.value === null ? labels.blank : item.text);
+  const shown =
+    search === '' ? items : items.filter((item) => includesFolded(textOf(item), search));
+  const drawn = shown.slice(0, DISTINCT_LIMIT);
+  const checkedShown = shown.filter((item) => checked.has(item.value)).length;
+  // One stop of Tab: the box that has it, which is "(Select all)" at first; a search may take it away.
+  const stop = Math.min(active, drawn.length);
+
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    applyRef.current = () => {
+      const selection = headerSelection(
+        items.map((item) => item.value),
+        [...checked],
+      );
+      apply(withHeaderCondition(filter, column.id, selection?.values, selection?.exclude ?? false));
+      return true;
+    };
+  });
+
+  const toggle = (value: unknown, on: boolean) =>
+    setChecked((now) => {
+      const next = new Set(now);
+      if (on) next.add(value);
+      else next.delete(value);
+      return next;
+    });
+  const toggleShown = (on: boolean) =>
+    setChecked((now) => {
+      const next = new Set(now);
+      for (const item of shown) {
+        if (on) next.add(item.value);
+        else next.delete(item.value);
+      }
+      return next;
+    });
+
+  const boxes = () => Array.from(listRef.current?.querySelectorAll('input') ?? []);
+  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
+    focusNext(event, boxes(), { orientation: 'vertical', loop: false });
+  };
+  // ↓ in the search field goes down into the list, to its one stop.
+  const intoList = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+    if (event.key !== 'ArrowDown' || hasModifier(event) || isComposing(event)) return;
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const stops = boxes().filter((input) => !input.disabled);
+    (stops.find((input) => input.tabIndex === 0) ?? stops[0])?.focus();
+  };
+  const onFocus = (event: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
+    const index = boxes().indexOf(event.target as HTMLInputElement);
+    if (index >= 0) setActive(index);
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <>
+      <SearchField
+        size="sm"
+        aria-label={labels.searchValuesName}
+        placeholder={labels.searchValues}
+        value={search}
+        onValueChange={setSearch}
+        onKeyDown={intoList}
+      />
+      {/* The keys are those of the boxes inside it; the group only moves the focus among them. */}
+      {/* eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions */}
+      <div
+        ref={listRef}
+        role="group"
+        aria-label={labels.filterColumn(column.caption, false)}
+        className="flg-data-grid-value-list"
+        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
+        onFocus={onFocus}
+      >
+        <Checkbox
+          tabIndex={stop === 0 ? 0 : -1}
+          disabled={shown.length === 0}
+          checked={shown.length > 0 && checkedShown === shown.length}
+          indeterminate={checkedShown > 0 && checkedShown < shown.length}
+          onCheckedChange={toggleShown}
+        >
+          {labels.selectAllValues}
+        </Checkbox>
+        <Divider decorative />
+        {drawn.map((item, index) => (
+          <Checkbox
+            key={keyOf(item.value)}
+            className={item.value === null ? 'flg-data-grid-value-blank' : undefined}
+            tabIndex={stop === index + 1 ? 0 : -1}
+            checked={checked.has(item.value)}
+            onCheckedChange={(on) => toggle(item.value, on)}
+          >
+            {textOf(item)}
+          </Checkbox>
+        ))}
+      </div>
+      {shown.length > drawn.length ? (
+        <p className="flg-data-grid-value-more">{labels.moreValues(drawn.length, shown.length)}</p>
+      ) : null}
+    </>
+  );
+}

+import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridColumnLayout, DataGridFilter, DataGridProps } from './index';
+
+// The filter panel (spec phase 6 §4.3 F1 "Thanh bộ lọc", §6.3 "Lọc"): the conditions in words, the button
+// that clears them and the switch that turns them off. What needs a layout engine (the size of its parts,
+// the wrap of its words, the pager under it) is proven in the stories (`DataGridFiltering.stories.tsx`).
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  qty: number;
+  status: string;
+  placed: string;
+  paid: boolean;
+}
+
+const STATUSES = ['new', 'processing', 'delivered', 'cancelled'];
+const ORDERS: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({
+  id: `DH-${1000 + index}`,
+  customer: index % 3 === 0 ? `Công ty ${index + 1}` : `Minh ${index + 1}`,
+  qty: index + 1,
+  status: STATUSES[index % 4]!,
+  placed: `2026-11-${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
+  paid: index % 2 === 0,
+}));
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 104 },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 200 },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 80 },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    caption: 'Status',
+    width: 140,
+    lookup: {
+      items: STATUSES.map((value) => ({ value, text: value[0]!.toUpperCase() + value.slice(1) })),
+      valueField: 'value',
+      displayField: 'text',
+    },
+  },
+  { field: 'placed', caption: 'Placed', dataType: 'date', width: 140 },
+  { field: 'paid', caption: 'Paid', dataType: 'boolean', width: 80 },
+];
+
+// F1's sentence: Customer contains ‘công ty’ and Qty > 5 and Status is any of (Processing).
+const F1: DataGridFilter = {
+  columns: {
+    customer: { operator: 'contains', value: 'công ty' },
+    qty: { operator: '>', value: 5 },
+    status: { values: ['processing'] },
+  },
+};
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      filterPanel
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const grid = () => screen.getByRole('grid') as HTMLTableElement;
+const panel = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-filter-panel');
+const dataRows = () => grid().querySelectorAll('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-row');
+// The panel's own button: a grid with no row left holds another "Clear filter", in its empty cell.
+const clear = () => within(panel()!).getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear filter' });
+const apply = () => screen.getByRole('switch', { name: 'Apply filter' }) as HTMLInputElement;
+const sentence = () => panel()!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-filter-text')!.textContent;
+// The words of the sentence as a list: a caption, its words, "and", and so on.
+const parts = () =>
+  Array.from(panel()!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-filter-text')!.childNodes, (node) =>
+    node.textContent?.trim(),
+  ).filter(Boolean);
+
+describe('the filter panel', () => {
+  describe('when it is there', () => {
+    it('is drawn only with filterPanel, and only for another value than true it is not', () => {
+      const { rerender } = render(<Orders filterPanel={false} defaultFilter={F1} />);
+      expect(panel()).toBeNull();
+      rerender(<Orders filterPanel={'yes' as never} defaultFilter={F1} />);
+      expect(panel()).toBeNull();
+      rerender(<Orders filterPanel defaultFilter={F1} />);
+      expect(panel()).not.toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('is not drawn while no column has a condition that filters, a search alone included', () => {
+      const { rerender } = render(<Orders />);
+      expect(panel()).toBeNull();
+      rerender(<Orders defaultFilter={{ search: 'minh' }} />);
+      expect(panel()).toBeNull();
+      // A condition held and ignored: no value, an operator the column does not offer, a column that is not there.
+      rerender(
+        <Orders
+          filter={{
+            columns: {
+              customer: { operator: 'contains', value: '' },
+              qty: { operator: 'contains' as never, value: 'x' },
+              nobody: { operator: '=', value: 'x' },
+            },
+          }}
+        />,
+      );
+      expect(panel()).toBeNull();
+    });
+
+    it('appears with the first condition and goes with the last, the grid kept', () => {
+      const { rerender } = render(<Orders filter={{}} onFilterChange={() => {}} />);
+      expect(panel()).toBeNull();
+      rerender(<Orders filter={F1} onFilterChange={() => {}} />);

+    it('stands between the frame and the pager, outside the table', () => {
+      render(<Orders defaultFilter={F1} paging={{ pageSize: 5 }} />);
+      const root = grid().closest('.flg-data-grid')!;
+      const classes = Array.from(root.children, (child) => child.className);
+      const at = (name: string) => classes.findIndex((value) => value.includes(name));
+      expect(at('flg-data-grid-main')).toBeLessThan(at('flg-data-grid-filter-panel'));
+      expect(at('flg-data-grid-filter-panel')).toBeLessThan(at('flg-data-grid-pager'));

+
+  describe('the words', () => {

+      expect(Array.from(text.querySelectorAll('b'), (bold) => bold.textContent)).toEqual([

+
+    it('says the row conditions before the header conditions, each in the order of the columns', () => {
+      render(
+        <Orders

+
+    it('says a range: both ends once, an open end as ≥ or ≤, and the blank of a header filter', () => {

+      expect(sentence()).toBe('Qty 5 – 9');

+    it('follows the filter when it changes, and says nothing of the search', () => {

+
+  describe('Clear filter', () => {

+    it('gives the focus to the active cell of the grid when the panel goes under it', async () => {

+    it('does not take the focus from where it is when it was not on the panel', async () => {

+
+  describe('Apply filter', () => {
+    it('is a switch named by labels.applyFilter, on while the conditions are enabled', () => {
+      render(<Orders defaultFilter={F1} labels={{ applyFilter: 'Bật bộ lọc' }} />);

+      expect(toggle.checked).toBe(true);

+
+    it('turns the conditions off with one change, and the rows are those the search keeps', () => {
+      const onFilterChange = vi.fn();

+        <Orders

+      // Customer contains "công ty" and Qty > 5 and Status processing, and the search "minh": no row.
+      expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(0);

+      expect(onFilterChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

+      expect(sentence()).toBe(
+        'Customer contains ‘công ty’ and Qty > 5 and Status is any of (Processing)',

+      expect(

+          .getByRole('button', { name: 'Filter Status (filtered)' })
+          .hasAttribute('data-active'),

+    });
+
+    it('turns them back on, and the key goes away rather than enabled: true', () => {
+      const onFilterChange = vi.fn();
+      render(<Orders defaultFilter={{ ...F1, enabled: false }} onFilterChange={onFilterChange} />);
+      expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(12);
+      fireEvent.click(apply());
+      expect(onFilterChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(onFilterChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(F1);
+      expect('enabled' in onFilterChange.mock.calls[0]![0]).toBe(false);
+      // Only DH-1009 is a "Công ty" order of more than 5 that is processing.
+      expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(1);
+    });
+
+    it('is a change like any other: the first page, and a controlled parent hears it', () => {
+      const onPageChange = vi.fn();
+      function Controlled() {
+        const [filter, setFilter] = useState<DataGridFilter>({
+          columns: { qty: { operator: '>', value: 2 } },
+        });

+          <Orders

+      render(<Controlled />);

+      expect(apply().checked).toBe(false);
+      expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(4);
+    });
+
+    it('keeps the focus on the switch', () => {
+      render(<Orders defaultFilter={F1} />);
+      act(() => apply().focus());
+      fireEvent.click(apply());
+      expect(apply()).toHaveFocus();
+      expect(panel()).not.toBeNull();
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('what it asks of the grid', () => {
+    it('is no new label warning: labels with records written in the JSX say what they said', () => {
+      const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+      const { rerender } = render(
+        <Orders defaultFilter={F1} labels={{ panelOperators: { contains: 'has' } }} />,
+      );

+        rerender(<Orders defaultFilter={F1} labels={{ panelOperators: { contains: 'has' } }} />);

+
+    it('has the filter funnel icon, aria-hidden, before the words', () => {
+      render(<Orders defaultFilter={F1} />);

+});

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.renders.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.renders.test.tsx
index d352ab9..05c2cd5 100644
--- a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.renders.test.tsx
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.renders.test.tsx
@@ -974,3 +974,70 @@ describe('the header filter', () => {
     expect(renders).toMatchObject({ headerCell: 0, cell: 0 });
   });
 });
+
+// The filter panel (phase 6 Plan D): a part of its own that reads the filter through the filter view, so
+// what it asks of the grid is a filter change like any other, and a record of words written in the JSX is
+// the same labels.
+describe('the filter panel', () => {
+  const rows = ORDERS.slice(0, 12);
+  const SOME = { columns: { qty: { operator: '<' as const, value: 5 } } };
+  const small = (props: Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof DataGrid<Order>>> = {}) => (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={rows}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      filterPanel
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+  const reset = () => {
+    for (const key of Object.keys(renders) as (keyof typeof renders)[]) renders[key] = 0;
+  };
+
+  it('draws no title and no row that stays when the switch turns the conditions off, only the rows that come', () => {
+    render(small({ defaultFilter: SOME }));
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('row')).toHaveLength(1 + 4);
+    reset();
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: 'Apply filter' }));
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('row')).toHaveLength(1 + 12);
+    // The 8 rows that come draw their 3 cells; the 4 that stay and the 3 titles do not.
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(8 * 3);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+    reset();
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: 'Apply filter' }));
+    expect(screen.getAllByRole('row')).toHaveLength(1 + 4);
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws no title and no row that stays when Clear filter takes the panel away', () => {
+    render(small({ defaultFilter: SOME }));
+    reset();
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear filter' }));
+    expect(document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-filter-panel')).toBeNull();
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(8 * 3);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws no row again for labels with a record and a filter written inline that say what they said', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      small({
+        labels: { panelOperators: { '<': 'below' } },
+        filter: { ...SOME },
+        onFilterChange: () => {},
+      }),
+    );
+    reset();
+    rerender(
+      small({
+        labels: { panelOperators: { '<': 'below' } },
+        filter: { ...SOME },
+        onFilterChange: () => {},
+      }),
+    );
+    expect(renders).toMatchObject({ headerCell: 0, cell: 0 });
+    expect(document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-filter-text')!.textContent).toBe('Qty below 5');
+  });
+});

+test('the filter panel: its prop, and the labels of its sentence', () => {
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridProps<Order>['filterPanel']>().toEqualTypeOf<boolean | undefined>();
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridLabels['and']>().toEqualTypeOf<string>();
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridLabels['isAnyOf']>().toEqualTypeOf<string>();
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridLabels['isNoneOf']>().toEqualTypeOf<string>();
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridLabels['applyFilter']>().toEqualTypeOf<string>();
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridLabels['quoted']>().toEqualTypeOf<(text: string) => string>();
+  // A range with one open end is said with `>=` or `<=`, so `between` has no word of its own here.
+  expectTypeOf<keyof DataGridLabels['panelOperators']>().toEqualTypeOf<
+    '=' | '<>' | '<' | '>' | '<=' | '>=' | 'contains' | 'notContains' | 'startsWith' | 'endsWith'
+  >();
+  // The record is given in part, as `operators` is.
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridLabelsInput['panelOperators']>().toEqualTypeOf<
+    Partial<DataGridLabels['panelOperators']> | undefined
+  >();
+  // @ts-expect-error the panel is on or off: a string is no value of filterPanel
+  const wrong: DataGridProps<Order> = { data: [], rowKey: 'id', columns: [], filterPanel: 'yes' };
+  void wrong;
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGridFiltering.stories.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGridFiltering.stories.tsx
index 0af96d9..bf0aa45 100644
--- a/src/components/data-grid/DataGridFiltering.stories.tsx
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGridFiltering.stories.tsx
@@ -1207,3 +1207,216 @@ export const HeaderFilterKeys: Story = {
     await expect(dataRowsOf(root)).not.toHaveLength(unfiltered);
   },
 };
+
+/** F1's sentence on the sales: Customer contains "công ty" and Qty > 5 and Status is any of (Processing). */
+const PANEL_FILTER: DataGridFilter = {
+  columns: {
+    customer: { operator: 'contains', value: 'công ty' },
+    qty: { operator: '>', value: 5 },
+    status: { values: ['processing'] },
+  },
+};
+const PANEL_PAGE = 4;
+/** The orders `PANEL_FILTER` keeps. */
+const PANEL_KEPT = SALES.filter(
+  (sale) =>
+    foldText(sale.customer).includes('cong ty') && sale.qty > 5 && sale.status === 'processing',
+);
+
+/** The grid of `FilterPanelToggle`, with a button outside it that brings the filter back. */
+const PanelGrid = ({
+  onFilterChange,
+}: {
+  onFilterChange: DataGridProps<Sale>['onFilterChange'];
+}) => {
+  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<DataGridFilter>(PANEL_FILTER);
+  return (
+    <div style={{ width: 1100, display: 'grid', gap: 14 }}>
+      <button type="button" onClick={() => setFilter(PANEL_FILTER)}>
+        Restore the filter
+      </button>
+      <DataGrid
+        aria-label="Orders"
+        data={SALES}
+        rowKey="id"
+        columns={HEADER_COLUMNS}
+        locale="vi-VN"
+        filterRow
+        headerFilter
+        filterPanel
+        paging={{ pageSize: PANEL_PAGE, pageSizes: [PANEL_PAGE, 8] }}
+        filter={filter}
+        onFilterChange={(next) => {
+          setFilter(next);
+          onFilterChange?.(next);
+        }}
+      />
+    </div>
+  );
+};
+
+/**
+ * The filter panel (spec phase 6 §4.3 F1 "Thanh bộ lọc"), in each engine: F1's sentence in a 38px bar with a
+ * 1px border and an 8px radius, an outline funnel of 14px first, the captions in semibold with "and" muted, the
+ * "Clear filter" link after the words and the "Apply filter" switch at the end, between the frame and the
+ * pager and cut nowhere. Tab from a cell reaches Clear and the switch; Space on the switch turns the
+ * conditions off (the rows are those the search keeps, the cells and the funnel still show the conditions)
+ * and on again, with the focus on the switch. Enter on Clear takes the conditions and the panel away, the
+ * pager moves up by the panel's height and its gap, and the focus goes to the active cell of the grid, never
+ * to the page; the button outside brings the filter back, and the pager down again.
+ */
+export const FilterPanelToggle: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { onFilterChange: fn() },
+  render: (args) => <PanelGrid onFilterChange={args.onFilterChange} />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const table = root.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role="grid"]')!;
+    const panel = () => root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-filter-panel')!;
+    const pager = () => root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-pager')!;
+    const clear = () =>
+      panel().querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('button.flg-data-grid-filter-clear')!;
+    const toggle = () => within(panel()).getByRole('switch', { name: 'Apply filter' });
+    const info = () => root.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-page-info')!.textContent;
+    const sentence = 'Customer contains ‘công ty’ and Qty > 5 and Status is any of (Processing)';
+    const kept = PANEL_KEPT.length;
+    await expect(kept, 'the filter keeps more orders than a page holds').toBeGreaterThan(
+      PANEL_PAGE,
+    );
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+
+    // The sentence and the look of the bar, measured: F1's 38px bar, 1px border, 8px radius, padding
+    // 3 6 3 12, parts 8px apart.
+    const text = panel().querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-filter-text')!;
+    await expect(text).toHaveTextContent(sentence);
+    const bar = getComputedStyle(panel());
+    await expect(panel().offsetHeight).toBe(38);
+    await expect(bar.borderTopWidth).toBe('1px');
+    await expect(bar.borderTopLeftRadius).toBe('8px');
+    await expect(bar.padding).toBe('3px 6px 3px 12px');
+    await expect(bar.columnGap).toBe('8px');
+    await expect(bar.alignItems).toBe('center');

Icon phễu của thanh (`--flg-accent-text`, `aria-hidden`) chỉ trang trí; chữ điều kiện là `--flg-text`.

Cùng cặp màu nên cùng số đo, không thêm dòng; ô `Checkbox` trong popover là điểm 2 và 5 đã có. Icon ổ khoá `aria-hidden`: ô đã tắt và có mô tả ẩn "Always shown", nên không thông tin nào chỉ nằm ở icon.

+  - "Trong khoảng" (ngoài mockup): ô là `Input` chỉ đọc ghi "1 – 5" (hay chữ chờ `labels.between`), bấm hay `Enter` mở một Popover giống Popover lọc ở header: hai `Field` "From", "To" với trình sửa của kiểu, Huỷ / OK. Phát hiện khi lập Plan D: ô là `Input` chỉ đọc có `role="combobox"` (`aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` khi mở: ô là chỗ popover trả focus về; `textbox` không nhận `aria-expanded`); chữ do một hàm (`rangeText`, dùng chung với thanh bộ lọc) viết với mỗi đầu như cột viết: `labels.range(từ, đến)` khi có hai đầu, còn một đầu để mở thì là `>=` hay `<=` với chữ của `labels.panelOperators` và giá trị ("≥ 5", "≤ 31/10/2026"; Claude chốt sau Task 5, phát hiện khi lập Plan D); popover là `.flg-popover.flg-data-grid-filter-popover` (kính, mũi tên, rộng 216px, `side="bottom" align="start"` dưới khung của ô, `role="dialog"` tên `labels.filterCell(caption)`), chỉ vẽ nội dung khi mở nên mỗi lần mở bắt đầu từ bộ lọc hiện tại; focus vào ô đầu khi mở; `Enter` (không trên nút) là OK, `Esc` và bấm ra ngoài là Huỷ; `Tab` qua control cuối và `Shift+Tab` trước control đầu đóng như Huỷ và trả focus về ô; OK ghi `[từ, đến]` (đầu để mở là `null`, cả hai rỗng là không giá trị, toán tử vẫn giữ), số không đọc được thì không đóng và focus vào ô đó; đổi sang hay từ `between` bỏ giá trị (hai đầu khác một giá trị).

 - **Popover lọc ở header:** kính `.flg-popover` có mũi tên, `side="bottom" align="center"` từ phễu, rộng 216px, cột `flex` khoảng cách 9px. Trên cùng: `SearchField` cỡ `sm` (chữ chờ `labels.searchValues`). Danh sách (`.flg-data-grid-value-list`): cột, mỗi dòng một `Checkbox` cao 28px, padding `0 4px`; dòng đầu "(Select all)" (`indeterminate` khi chọn một phần), rồi `Divider` margin `3px 0`, rồi các giá trị, cuối cùng "(Blanks)" chữ `--flg-text-muted`. Danh sách cuộn khi cao hơn 259px (9 dòng 28px cộng `Divider` 3px + 1px + 3px, ngoài mockup; phát hiện khi lập Plan D: 252px sẽ cắt dòng thứ chín vì `Divider`), là `role="group"` mang tên của popover (`labels.filterColumn(caption, false)`); ô tìm có tên `labels.searchValuesName` ("Search values"). Đáy: hàng `flex` căn cuối, khoảng cách 6px: Huỷ (`secondary` `sm`), OK (`primary` `sm`).
 - **Tô sáng của tìm kiếm** (`mark.flg-data-grid-match`): margin `0 -1px`, padding 1px, bo 3px, nền `--flg-highlight-bg`, chữ `--flg-highlight-text`, đậm `--flg-weight-semibold`. Trong một dòng đang chọn, nền `--flg-highlight-bg` trùng `--flg-accent-subtle` của dòng, nên phần khớp gần như chỉ còn chữ đậm (1.13:1 so với dòng). Spec không thêm màu riêng (Claude chốt, điểm mở): tô sáng chỉ là dấu hiệu phụ (dòng đó đã nằm trong kết quả), và chữ đậm vẫn còn.

Icon phễu 14px `--flg-accent-text`; chữ điều kiện: tên cột đậm `--flg-weight-semibold`, toán tử chữ thường, giá trị trong ngoặc đơn `‘ ’`, "và" (`labels.and`) màu `--flg-text-muted`; tập giá trị của lọc ở header ghi "thuộc (Đang xử lý)" (`labels.isAnyOf`) hay `labels.isNoneOf`. Nút "Xoá bộ lọc" Button `ghost` `sm` chữ `--flg-accent-text` (svg 13px nếu có). Khoảng giãn. `Switch` "Áp dụng bộ lọc" (`labels.applyFilter`). Phát hiện khi lập Plan D: (1) icon phễu của thanh là **nét viền, không đặc**: markup của mockup ghi cả `fill="none"` lẫn `fill="currentColor"` trên cùng một `<svg>`, trình duyệt giữ thuộc tính đầu nên ảnh đã duyệt vẽ phễu rỗng (phễu đặc là của nút trên tiêu đề cột đang lọc, `mk-fn[data-active]`); (2) DOM: `div.flg-data-grid-filter-panel` > `span.flg-data-grid-filter-icon` (`aria-hidden`), `span.flg-data-grid-filter-text`, `button.flg-data-grid-filter-clear`, `span.flg-data-grid-filter-spacer`, `label.flg-switch`; trong chữ: `<b>` tên cột, `span.flg-data-grid-filter-and`; chữ được xuống dòng (`min-width: 0`, `overflow-wrap: anywhere`), nút và công tắc giữ cỡ; (3) thứ tự câu: mọi điều kiện của hàng lọc trước, rồi mọi điều kiện của lọc ở header, mỗi nhóm theo thứ tự cột của layout (vùng ghim trái, giữa, vùng ghim phải, rồi các cột đang ẩn theo `order`); một cột có cả hai thì có hai điều kiện, mỗi cái ở nhóm của nó; (4) toán tử viết bằng `labels.panelOperators` (không có `between`): giá trị chuỗi trong `labels.quoted`, số, ngày, boolean và lookup viết như cột viết (`keyText`), `between` viết bằng `rangeText` ("5 – 9", "≥ 5", "≤ 31/10/2026", không thêm chữ toán tử), tập giá trị là `labels.isAnyOf` / `labels.isNoneOf` với các chữ của giá trị trong ngoặc, cách nhau ", " ("(Blanks)" cho `null`; chữ của `headerFilter.values` khi cột có); (5) thanh hiện khi có cột có điều kiện lọc được (`hasConditions`, kể cả khi `enabled: false`; tìm kiếm một mình không có), không hiện khi `filterPanel` không phải `true`; (6) "Xoá bộ lọc" xoá tìm kiếm và mọi điều kiện (`clear`) và `enabled`; thanh biến mất khi đang giữ focus thì focus về ô hoạt động của grid (trình duyệt không bắn `blur` khi gỡ phần tử đang focus, nên thanh tự nhớ nó có focus hay không); công tắc ghi `enabled: false`, bật lại thì bỏ khoá `enabled` (không ghi `enabled: true`); (7) thanh nằm ngoài `<table>`, là điểm Tab riêng sau bảng (Xoá bộ lọc rồi công tắc) và trước thanh phân trang, cách khung và thanh phân trang 14px (khoảng cách của gốc, G1).
 - **Trống do lọc:** ô trải mọi cột, padding `26px 12px`, căn giữa, xuống dòng được; bên trong cột căn giữa khoảng cách 8px: vòng 38px nền `--flg-control-track` với `FunnelXIcon` 18px `--flg-text-muted`; tiêu đề `labels.noMatches` `--flg-text-sm` đậm `--flg-weight-semibold`; Button `secondary` `sm` "Xoá bộ lọc". Phát hiện khi lập Plan D: `div.flg-data-grid-empty-content` giữ hộp của `noData` và mang `data-filtered`, trong đó `span.flg-data-grid-empty-icon` (vòng, `aria-hidden`), `span.flg-data-grid-empty-title` và nút; ô `td` mang `data-home="control"` và `tabindex="-1"`, nút là Tab stop khi ô là vị trí hoạt động (§3.6 "Vị trí hoạt động"). Grid là "trống do lọc" khi không có dòng để hiện và `isFiltering` (có tìm kiếm, hoặc điều kiện đang bật mà một cột có điều kiện lọc được), cả ở chế độ server (khi `data` rỗng). Forced colours: vòng mất nền, viền 1px `CanvasText`, icon `CanvasText` (§4.5 không nói tới vòng).

 ```
 
+## The filter panel
+
+`filterPanel` draws a bar between the grid and its pager that says what the filter is, in words, with
+a button that clears it and a switch that puts the conditions aside. Any value of `filterPanel` other
+than `true` is `false`.
+
+```tsx
+<DataGrid data={orders} rowKey="id" columns={columns} caption="Orders" filterRow filterPanel />
+```
+
+**When it is there.** The panel is drawn while some column has a condition that filters, and the
+search alone does not make one. It stays when the switch has put the conditions aside, so the person
+can turn them on again, and it goes with the last condition. It is outside the table, 14px from the
+grid and from the pager, and it is two stops of Tab after the grid: Clear filter, then the switch.
+
+**The words.** Each condition is the caption of its column in semibold, then what it asks. The
+conditions of the filter row come first and those of the header filter after them, each in the order
+of the columns: the left zone, the middle, the right zone, and the columns that are hidden last,
+because a hidden column goes on filtering. A column that has both has two. "and" (`labels.and`) is
+muted and stands between them. The words wrap, and are never cut.
+
+| Condition                     | Is said as                                  |
+| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
+| text with an operator         | `Customer contains ‘ltd’` (`labels.quoted`) |
+| a number, a day, a lookup     | `Qty > 5`, `Order date ≥ 05/11/2026`        |
+| `between` with both ends      | `Qty 5 – 9` (`labels.range`)                |
+| `between` with one open end   | `Qty ≥ 5`, `Order date ≤ 31/10/2026`        |
+| a header condition            | `Status is any of (New, Processing)`        |
+| a header condition, `exclude` | `Status is none of (Cancelled)`             |
+
+The operators are the words of `labels.panelOperators` (`=`, `≠`, `<`, `>`, `≤`, `≥`, "contains", "does
+not contain", "starts with", "ends with"), a record that may be given in part; `between` is not one,
+since a range is said with `labels.range` or with `≥` or `≤`, and so is the field of a range in the
+filter row. A value is written as its column writes it, a lookup by its text, a boolean by
+`labels.yes` and `labels.no`, a blank by `labels.blank`; in server mode a value that the column's
+`headerFilter.values` lists is written by its `text`. `labels.isAnyOf` and `labels.isNoneOf` say a
+header condition.
+
+**Clear filter.** The button clears the search and every condition, and `enabled` with them, as
+`clearFilter()` does: one `onFilterChange`, the first page, the rows found. The panel goes with the
+filter, and when the focus was on the button it goes to the active cell of the grid, and never to
+the page.
+
+**Apply filter.** The switch is `filter.enabled`. Turned off, the grid shows every row that the
+search keeps, the panel stays, and the cells of the filter row and the funnels go on showing the
+conditions that were put aside. It is a change like any other: one `onFilterChange` with
+`enabled: false`, and turning it on takes the key away instead of writing `enabled: true`. Its name
+is `labels.applyFilter`.
+

 ## Props
 
-| Prop                   | Type                                        | Default      | Does                                                               |
-| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
-| `data`                 | `readonly TRow[]`                           |              | The rows                                                           |
-| `rowKey`               | `keyof TRow` or `(row) => string \| number` |              | What a row is known by                                             |
-| `columns`              | `readonly DataGridColumn<TRow>[]`           |              | The columns; a stable array                                        |
-| `caption`              | `ReactNode`                                 |              | The title and the name                                             |
-| `description`          | `ReactNode`                                 |              | What the grid is about                                             |
-| `captionAs`            | `'h2'` to `'h6'` or `'div'`                 | `'h3'`       | The element of the caption                                         |
-| `toolbar`              | `false \| (items) => ReactNode`             |              | `false` keeps the caption only; a function places the items        |
-| `variant`              | `'lined' \| 'striped' \| 'minimal'`         | `'lined'`    | The look of a Table                                                |
-| `density`              | `'compact' \| 'standard' \| 'comfortable'`  | `'standard'` | The height of a row                                                |
-| `rowHeight`            | `number`                                    |              | The height of a row in pixels, over the table's                    |
-| `locale`               | `string`                                    | `'en-US'`    | The language of numbers and dates (see below)                      |
-| `timeZone`             | `string`                                    | `'UTC'`      | The zone a `datetime` is shown in                                  |
-| `height`               | `number \| string`                          |              | The height of the grid; with it the heading sticks                 |
-| `scrolling`            | `'standard' \| 'virtual'`                   | `'standard'` | `'virtual'` draws only the rows near the view                      |
-| `loading`              | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | Skeleton rows with no row, a layer over the rows                   |
-| `rowClassName`         | `(row) => string \| undefined`              |              | A class for a row; a stable function                               |
-| `allowSorting`         | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowSorting`                       |
-| `allowResizing`        | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowResizing`                      |
-| `allowReordering`      | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowReordering`                    |
-| `allowPinning`         | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowPinning`                       |
-| `allowHiding`          | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowHiding`                        |
-| `sortMode`             | `'single' \| 'multiple'`                    | `'multiple'` | Whether a press with a modifier adds a level                       |
-| `sort`                 | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`               |              | The sort, in order (controlled)                                    |
-| `defaultSort`          | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`               |              | The sort at first                                                  |
-| `onSortChange`         | `(sort) => void`                            |              | Called with the sort a press asks for                              |
-| `filter`               | `DataGridFilter`                            |              | The search and the conditions of the columns (controlled)          |
-| `defaultFilter`        | `DataGridFilter`                            |              | The filter at first                                                |
-| `onFilterChange`       | `(filter) => void`                          |              | Called with the filter a change asks for                           |
-| `paging`               | `false \| { pageSize?, pageSizes? }`        | see above    | A page's size at first, and the sizes offered                      |
-| `page`                 | `DataGridPage`                              |              | The page, from 0 (controlled)                                      |

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterPanel.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterPanel.tsx

index 0000000..cd9e80b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/FilterPanel.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+import { Fragment, memo, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
+import type { FocusEvent } from 'react';
+import { FunnelIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import { Button } from '../../button/Button';
+import { Switch } from '../../switch/Switch';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { conditionTexts, withEnabled } from '../engine/filter';
+import { useFilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import type { DataGridLabels } from '../types';
+
+interface FilterPanelProps<TRow> {
+  /**
+   * The columns in the order the sentence says them: the shown ones in the order of their zones, then the
+   * hidden ones. The grid keeps the list by its members, so a width or a sort draws nothing here.
+   */
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+  /** Gives the focus to the active cell of the grid, for when the panel goes with the focus on it. */
+  restoreFocus: () => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The bar between the grid and its pager that says what the filter is (spec phase 6 §4.3 F1 "Thanh bộ
+ * lọc", §6.3 "Lọc"): a funnel, the conditions of the columns in words (`conditionTexts`: the caption in
+ * semibold, the operator, the value, `labels.and` muted between), the button that clears the search and
+ * every condition, and the switch that turns the conditions off without losing them (`filter.enabled`).
+ * The grid draws it while some column has a condition that filters, and a search alone does not give one.
+ * It is outside the table, a stop of Tab of its own after the grid; what it asks goes through the same
+ * `apply` of the grid as a cell of the filter row does.
+ *
+ * Clearing takes the panel away with the focus on its button, which a browser would drop to the page: the
+ * focus goes to the active cell of the grid after the commit that removed it (the browser fires no blur for
+ * a focused element that is removed, so the panel keeps its own count of whether the focus is in it).
+ */
+function FilterPanelView<TRow>({ columns, labels, restoreFocus }: FilterPanelProps<TRow>) {
+  const { filter, apply, clear } = useFilterView();
+  const texts = useMemo(() => conditionTexts(filter, columns, labels), [filter, columns, labels]);
+  const focused = useRef(false);
+  const restore = useRef(restoreFocus);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    restore.current = restoreFocus;
+  });
+  // After the commit that removes the panel the grid shows its rows again, and the place it has is the
+  // one to give the focus to, so it is asked a moment after the commit and not in it.
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(
+    () => () => {
+      if (focused.current) queueMicrotask(() => restore.current());
+    },
+    [],
+  );
+  return (
+    <div
+      className="flg-data-grid-filter-panel"
+      onFocus={() => {
+        focused.current = true;
+      }}
+      onBlur={(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
+        if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) focused.current = false;
+      }}
+    >
+      <span className="flg-data-grid-filter-icon" aria-hidden="true">
+        <FunnelIcon width={14} height={14} />
+      </span>
+      <span className="flg-data-grid-filter-text">
+        {texts.map((item, index) => (
+          <Fragment key={`${item.id}:${item.part}`}>
+            {index > 0 ? (
+              <>
+                <span className="flg-data-grid-filter-and">{labels.and}</span>{' '}
+              </>
+            ) : null}
+            <b>{item.caption}</b> {item.words}
+            {index < texts.length - 1 ? ' ' : null}
+          </Fragment>
+        ))}
+      </span>
+      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="flg-data-grid-filter-clear" onClick={clear}>
+        {labels.clearFilter}
+      </Button>
+      <span className="flg-data-grid-filter-spacer" />
+      <Switch
+        checked={filter.enabled !== false}
+        onCheckedChange={(enabled) => apply(withEnabled(filter, enabled))}
+      >
+        {labels.applyFilter}
+      </Switch>
+    </div>
+  );
+}
+
+/** The panel, kept while its columns, labels and focus function are the same. */
+export const FilterPanel = memo(FilterPanelView) as typeof FilterPanelView;

diff --git a/src/styles/components/data-grid.css b/src/styles/components/data-grid.css
index c4a634e..9182de3 100644
--- a/src/styles/components/data-grid.css

@@ -1088,4 +1088,58 @@
   .flg-data-grid-pager > .flg-pagination {
     margin-left: auto;
   }
+
+  /* The filter panel (the approved crop of F1, "Thanh bộ lọc"): a bar between the grid and its pager that
+     says the conditions in words, with the button that clears them and the switch that turns them off at
+     its end. A row of the control's own look: 38px at least, a 1px border and the secondary control fill.
+     The words may wrap, and a long sentence takes the room the spacer leaves (it has none to give then),
+     never the button and the switch, which keep their size. The caption is semibold and "and" is muted;
+     the funnel is an outline in the accent text, as the approved page draws it (its markup says both
+     `fill="none"` and `fill="currentColor"`, and a browser keeps the first), unlike the funnel of a column
+     that has a header condition, which is filled. */
+  .flg-data-grid-filter-panel {
+    box-sizing: border-box;
+    display: flex;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 8px;
+    min-width: 0;
+    min-height: 38px;
+    padding: 3px 6px 3px 12px;
+    border: 1px solid var(--flg-control-border);
+    border-radius: var(--flg-radius-md);
+    background: var(--flg-control-bg-secondary);
+    color: var(--flg-text);
+    font-size: var(--flg-text-sm);
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-filter-icon {
+    display: inline-flex;
+    flex: none;
+    color: var(--flg-accent-text);
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-filter-icon > svg {
+    width: 14px;
+    height: 14px;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-filter-text {
+    min-width: 0;
+    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-filter-text > b {
+    font-weight: var(--flg-weight-semibold);
+  }
+  .flg-data-grid-filter-and {
+    color: var(--flg-text-muted);
+  }
+  /* The button is a ghost Button in the accent text; the rule names the variant so that it is as specific

+  .flg-button.flg-data-grid-filter-clear[data-variant='ghost'] {

+/** The statuses of the lookup, in the order F1 lists them and the order Status sorts by. */
+const STATUS_ITEMS = [
+  { id: 'new', name: 'New' },
+  { id: 'processing', name: 'Processing' },
+  { id: 'delivered', name: 'Delivered' },
+  { id: 'cancelled', name: 'Cancelled' },
+];
+const STATUS_LOOKUP = { items: STATUS_ITEMS, valueField: 'id', displayField: 'name' };
+/** The place of a status in the lookup, a blank one last. */
+const statusRank = (status: string | null | undefined) =>
+  status ? STATUS_ITEMS.findIndex((item) => item.id === status) : STATUS_ITEMS.length;
+
+/**
+ * G1's eight columns with the filter parts of D: Status a lookup (its funnel lists the four statuses and it
+ * sorts in their order), Assignee's cell calling `ctx.highlight`, and no funnel on Order, Qty and Total (G1

+ * with its sort level, its funnel and the room of the ⋮ is cut in them (measured: 9px and 8px short). Customer gives the 20px back, so the
+ * nine columns still sum to 1292.
+ */
+const G1_COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Sale>[] = SEARCH_COLUMNS.map((column) => {
+  const field = 'field' in column ? column.field : undefined;
+  if (field === 'id' || field === 'qty' || field === 'total')
+    return { ...column, allowHeaderFiltering: false };
+  if (field === 'customer') return { ...column, width: 228 };
+  if (field === 'date') return { ...column, width: 150 };
+  if (field === 'channel') return { ...column, width: 130 };
+  if (field === 'status')
+    return { ...column, lookup: STATUS_LOOKUP, sortValue: (row: Sale) => statusRank(row.status) };

+  // No "minh" in the row.
+  filterOrder('DH-1035', 'Tạp hóa Hoa Mai', VO_LAN, '2026-11-11', 'new', 'Website', 5, 4500000),
+  filterOrder(
+    'DH-1033',

+  ),
+  filterOrder('DH-1021', 'Công ty Hải Âu', VO_LAN, '2026-11-02', 'cancelled', 'Store', 18, 9900000),
+  filterOrder(
+    'DH-1014',
+    'Công ty Sao Mai',
+    LE_HUY,
+    '2026-10-29',

+    'Website',
+    22,
+    8800000,
+  ),
+  // "Minh" but no "công ty".
+  filterOrder(
+    'DH-1034',
+    'Nhà hàng Sen Vàng',
+    MINH_ANH,
+    '2026-11-10',
+    'delivered',
+    'Store',
+    9,
+    2200000,
+  ),
+  filterOrder('DH-1030', 'Studio Ánh Dương', MINH_ANH, '2026-11-07', 'new', 'Phone', 25, 9750000),
+  filterOrder('DH-1017', 'Minh Châu Spa', VO_LAN, '2026-10-30', 'processing', 'Store', 14, 7700000),
+  filterOrder('DH-1003', 'Đỗ Khánh Linh', MINH_ANH, '2026-10-25', null, 'Website', 3, 1250000),
+  // "Công ty" and "minh", but a Qty of 5 or less.
+  filterOrder(
+    'DH-1020',
+    'Công ty Minh Đức',
+    MINH_ANH,
+    '2026-11-01',
+    'processing',
+    'Phone',
+    4,
+    3320000,
+  ),
+  filterOrder('DH-1007', 'Công ty Minh Hải', LE_HUY, '2026-10-26', 'new', 'Store', 2, 1100000),
+  filterOrder(
+    'DH-0999',
+    'Công ty Bình Minh',
+    MINH_ANH,
+    '2026-10-23',
+    'delivered',
+    'Website',
+    5,
+    2100000,
+  ),
+  // Neither.
+  filterOrder(
+    'DH-1011',
+    'Cà phê Sương Sớm',
+    LE_HUY,
+    '2026-10-28',
+    'delivered',
+    'Store',
+    25,
+    9750000,
+  ),
+  filterOrder('DH-1005', 'Trần Thu Hà', VO_LAN, '2026-10-26', 'new', 'Phone', 2, 1250000),
+];
+
+/** The badge of a status, as G1's cell draws it; a blank status draws nothing. */
+const F1_BADGES = {
+  new: { variant: 'accent', text: 'New' },
+  processing: { variant: 'warning', text: 'Processing' },
+  delivered: { variant: 'success', text: 'Delivered' },
+  cancelled: { variant: 'danger', text: 'Cancelled' },
+} as const;
+
+/**
+ * F1's eight columns and widths (110, 220, 200, 160, 150, 140, 110, and Total takes the rest of the 1292px),
+ * without the column of boxes. G1 decides the funnels: none on Order, Qty and Total, and one on Order date.
+ */
+const F1_COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<FilterOrder>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 110, allowHeaderFiltering: false },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 220 },
+  {
+    field: 'assignee',
+    caption: 'Assignee',
+    width: 200,
+    cell: ({ text, highlight }: DataGridCellContext<FilterOrder, string>) => (
+      <span
+        style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, verticalAlign: 'middle' }}
+      >
+        <Avatar size="sm" alt="" fallback={ASSIGNEES[text]} />
+        {highlight(text)}
+      </span>
+    ),
+  },
+  { field: 'date', caption: 'Order date', dataType: 'date', width: 160 },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    caption: 'Status',
+    width: 150,
+    lookup: STATUS_LOOKUP,
+    sortValue: (row) => statusRank(row.status),
+    cell: ({ value }) =>
+      value ? <Badge variant={F1_BADGES[value].variant}>{F1_BADGES[value].text}</Badge> : null,
+  },
+  { field: 'channel', caption: 'Channel', width: 140 },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 110, allowHeaderFiltering: false },
+  {
+    field: 'total',
+    caption: 'Total',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' },
+    allowHeaderFiltering: false,
+  },
+];
+
+/** The first crop's filter: the search, Customer containing "công ty", Qty over 5, Status Processing only. */
+const F1_FILTER: DataGridFilter = {
+  search: 'minh',
+  columns: {
+    customer: { operator: 'contains', value: 'công ty' },
+    qty: { operator: '>', value: 5 },
+    status: { values: ['processing'] },
+  },
+};
+
+/** The look of both crops: a 1332px card, as G1's, with the frame as wide as the columns, 1292px. */
+const F1Card = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
+  <div className="f1-look" style={{ width: 1332 }}>
+    <style>{'.f1-look .flg-table-frame { scrollbar-width: none; }'}</style>
+    <Card>{children}</Card>
+  </div>
+);
+
+/**
+ * F1's first crop (mockup phase-6-grid-data.html, `mk-f1`): the grid with every part of the filter: the filter
+ * row with its operators (Customer's "contains" and Qty's ">" accented), the funnel of Status with the
+ * track background and its popover open (the search field, "(Select all)" mixed, New, Processing checked,
+ * Delivered, Cancelled and "(Blanks)"), "minh" searched and marked in Customer and in Assignee's custom
+ * cell, the filter panel and the pager "1–6 of 6". The play opens the popover with a click; the stage
+ * holds the room of the popover and the play asserts that it ends inside.
+ */
+export const GridFiltering: Story = {
+  tags: ['viewport-1440x720'],
+  render: () => (
+    <F1Card>
+      <DataGrid
+        data={F1_ORDERS}
+        rowKey="id"
+        columns={F1_COLUMNS}
+        caption="Orders"
+        variant="lined"
+        locale="vi-VN"
+        defaultSort={[{ field: 'date', direction: 'desc' }]}
+        paging={{ pageSize: 12, pageSizes: [12, 24, 48] }}
+        searchPanel
+        filterRow
+        headerFilter
+        filterPanel
+        columnChooser
+        defaultFilter={F1_FILTER}
+      />
+    </F1Card>
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const rows = () => dataRowsOf(root);
+    // The search is applied after its delay: the six rows come, each with its marks.
+    await waitFor(() => expect(rows(), 'the six orders').toHaveLength(6), SEARCH_APPLIED);
+    await expect(rows().map((row) => row.textContent?.slice(0, 7))).toEqual([
+      'DH-1024',
+      'DH-1019',
+      'DH-1012',
+      'DH-1006',
+      'DH-0997',
+      'DH-0988',
+    ]);
+    await expect(root.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-pager')).toHaveTextContent('1–6 of 6');
+    await expect(root.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input[type="search"]')).toHaveValue('minh');
+    await expect(
+      Array.from(rows()[0]!.querySelectorAll('mark'), (mark) => mark.textContent),
+      'Customer and Assignee mark "Minh"',
+    ).toEqual(['Minh', 'Minh']);
+    await expect(
+      Array.from(rows()[1]!.querySelectorAll('mark'), (mark) => mark.textContent),
+    ).toEqual(['Minh']);
+    // The filter row: Customer and Qty hold their conditions and their accented operators.
+    await expect(filterCellOf(root, 'Customer').querySelector('input')).toHaveValue('công ty');
+    await expect(filterCellOf(root, 'Qty').querySelector('input')).toHaveValue('5');
+    for (const caption of ['Customer', 'Qty'])
+      await expect(
+        filterCellOf(root, caption).querySelector('.flg-data-grid-operator'),
+        caption,
+      ).toHaveAttribute('data-active');
+    await expect(
+      filterCellOf(root, 'Assignee').querySelector('.flg-data-grid-operator'),
+    ).not.toHaveAttribute('data-active');
+    // The panel says the three conditions.
+    await expect(root.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-filter-panel')).toHaveTextContent(
+      'Customer contains ‘công ty’ and Qty > 5 and Status is any of (Processing)',
+    );
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+
+    // Status's funnel opens the popover: its search field, the "(Select all)" box mixed, the four statuses and
+    // the blanks, Processing alone checked.
+    const funnel = funnelOf(root, 'Status');
+    await expect(funnel).toHaveAttribute('data-active');
+    await userEvent.click(funnel);
+    const popover = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-filter-popover')!;
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(popover.matches(':popover-open'), 'the popover is open').toBe(true),
+      POPUP_SHOWN,
+    );
+    await settled(popover);
+    await expect(funnel).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
+    const labels = Array.from(popover.querySelectorAll('label'), (label) => label.textContent);
+    await expect(labels).toEqual([
+      '(Select all)',
+      'New',
+      'Processing',
+      'Delivered',
+      'Cancelled',
+      '(Blanks)',
+    ]);
+    const boxes = Array.from(popover.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('input[type="checkbox"]'));
+    await expect(boxes.map((box) => box.checked)).toEqual([
+      false,
+      false,
+      true,
+      false,
+      false,
+      false,
+    ]);
+    await expect(boxes[0]).toBePartiallyChecked();
+    await endsInsideTheStage(canvasElement, popover);
+    near(
+      popover.getBoundingClientRect().top - funnel.getBoundingClientRect().bottom,
+      F1_GAP,
+      1.5,
+      'the popover is under the funnel as in F1',
+    );
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * F1's second crop, "Trống do lọc" (mockup phase-6-grid-data.html, `mk-f1`): no toolbar (it has no caption, so
+ * its name is `aria-label`), the filter row with Customer's "công ty" and Qty's "> 500", the empty cell
+ * with its ring and the crossed-out funnel, the words and "Clear filter", and the filter panel. No pager:
+ * there are no rows to page.
+ */
+export const GridFilterEmpty: Story = {
+  tags: ['viewport-1440x720'],
+  render: () => (
+    <F1Card>
+      <DataGrid
+        aria-label="Orders"
+        data={F1_ORDERS}
+        rowKey="id"
+        columns={F1_COLUMNS}
+        variant="lined"
+        locale="vi-VN"
+        defaultSort={[{ field: 'date', direction: 'desc' }]}
+        paging={false}
+        filterRow
+        headerFilter
+        filterPanel
+        defaultFilter={{
+          columns: {
+            customer: { operator: 'contains', value: 'công ty' },
+            qty: { operator: '>', value: 500 },
+          },
+        }}
+      />
+    </F1Card>
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    await expect(dataRowsOf(root)).toHaveLength(0);
+    await expect(root.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-toolbar')).toBeNull();
+    await expect(root.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-pager')).toBeNull();
+    const content = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-empty-content')!;
+    await expect(content.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-empty-title')).toHaveTextContent(
+      'No rows match the filter',
+    );
+    await expect(content.querySelector('button')).toHaveTextContent('Clear filter');
+    await expect(filterCellOf(root, 'Qty').querySelector('input')).toHaveValue('500');
+    await expect(root.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-filter-panel')).toHaveTextContent(
+      'Customer contains ‘công ty’ and Qty > 500',
+    );
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+  },
+};
```

 Rows of data in typed columns, drawn in the look of a [Table](?path=/docs/components-table--docs).
 The grid is the part of the library that knows about the data. It is built in steps: today it reads
 the columns, formats each value for its type and its locale, draws the rows with a sticky heading,
-sorts them, pages them, chooses rows, draws a long list by windows, searches their text with a field
-and marks what it finds, says when it loads and when it is empty, and has a keyboard.
+sorts them, pages them, chooses rows, draws a long list by windows, filters them (a search field that
+marks what it finds, a row of filter cells, a funnel on each title that lists the values, and a bar
+that says the conditions), says when it loads and when it is empty, and has a keyboard.
 
 **It is not released yet.** The grid is built in steps, and it is not exported from the package
 until the last of them, so this page and its stories are not in the sidebar of the published docs.

Build, rồi ghi ngưỡng kích thước. Plan không chép `.size-limit.json`: `size:record` tự ghi file đó. `pnpm check:package` chạy sau, vì với ngưỡng cũ bước `size` của nó fail (phát hiện 17):

```bash
pnpm gen:theme
pnpm build
pnpm size:record
pnpm check:package
```

Expected: `size:record` ghi ngưỡng mới gần JS (all exports) 63728 B, JS (DataGrid) 66027 B, CSS 20786 B (trước: 63686 B, 49583 B, 20147 B), là kết quả ở bản nháp; ngưỡng là số đo cộng 10% (số đo ở bản nháp: 57.93 kB, 60.02 kB, 18.9 kB). Nếu số khác một chút, giữ số do `size:record` ghi và nêu trong báo cáo. `pnpm check:package`: PASS với ngưỡng mới.

Kiểm tra cuối của cả nhánh, như Claude chạy trên bản nháp (`check-p6d.sh`), cộng story theo từng thư mục, từng project và từng trình duyệt:

```bash
pnpm gen:theme
pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check
npx tsc --noEmit -p .
pnpm check:name
pnpm check:contrast
pnpm build && pnpm check:package
pnpm size
pnpm vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=3
pnpm vitest run --project unit-react18 --maxWorkers=3
pnpm vitest run --project scripts --maxWorkers=3
